About the position
We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our team based in Cape Town, this is a contracting role and onsite.
The Data Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the data infrastructure necessary for our Insights team to analyze data and derive valuable insights. The Data Engineer will work with Engineering Leads, Data Architects and other stakeholders to ensure that our data is properly sourced, stored, and accessible for analysis. They will also contribute to our mission by extracting maximum predictive value from data assets.
Responsibilities
Data Pipeline Development and Management
Design, develop, test and maintain data pipelines to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into a data warehouse or data lake
Implement data quality and validation checks to ensure that data is accurate, complete and consistent.
Optimize and scale data processing and storage to handle large volumes of data and high concurrency.
Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline issues and perform root cause analysis
Develop and maintain documentation for data pipelines and processes.
ETL Development
Building and maintaining data pipelines using lakehouse architecture (medallion)
Extracting data from multiple sources, transforming it, and loading it into the target database
Monitoring and troubleshooting ETL jobs to ensure they complete successfully and on time.
Data Modelling and Design
Design and implement data models and database schemas for storing and querying data.
Optimize database schema and indexing for efficient data retrieval
Modernise legacy data environments, migrating from on-premises solutions to cloud-native platforms such as Databricks
Ensure database security, availability, and scalability
Perform database tuning and optimization to improve query performance
Develop and maintain data connectors and integrations with various data sources (e.g., databases, APIs, flat files)
Implement data streaming and real-time data processing technologies.
Reporting And Analytics
Designing and implementing complex reports that meet business requirements
Developing dashboards and visualizations using tools like Pyramid or other data visualization tools
Develop and maintain BI reports and dashboards
Analysing data to identify trends, patterns, and insights
Providing insights to business stakeholders based on the analysis of data
Data Governance and Security
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations according the Data privacy policies.
Develop and maintain data governance policies, procedures, and standards
Ensure that data access and authorization policies are in place and adhered to
Monitor and audit data access to ensure data security and prevent data breaches
Implement disaster recovery and business continuity plans for data infrastructure
Collaboration and Communication
Work collaboratively with Engineering Leads, Architects, Analysts, Scrum Masters and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and provide data solutions.
Communicate data pipeline issues, status, and progress to stakeholders and project teams.
Participate in cross-functional meetings and initiatives to ensure alignment with data strategies and goals
Qualifications
Must have at least 3 years of relevant IT experience or related qualification.
3+ years experience with Data pipeline design and development experience.
Proficiency in Python and/or SQL.
RDBMS experience in technology such as SQL Server, MySQL and PostgreSQL.
Ability to use common scripting languages such as Powershell, Bash, or Python for automation.
Experience using unit and integration tests.
Experience working with production BI environments and tools such as PowerBI, Tableau or Pyramid Analytics.
Strong analytical/problem solving skills.
Skills
Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate certification.
Experience in Azure data technologies; a relevant Azure certification would be advantageous
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD practices, Docker and containerization
Exposure to .net entity framework.
Exposure to Databricks, Delta Lake and PySpark.
Experience with data streaming or distributed processing technologies such as Kafka or Hadoop.
Experience delivering data projects in Retail, Finance, Customer or HR domains would be advantageous
Experience mentoring junior engineers would be advantageous
Behaviours
Manages Complexity - interprets and simplifies complex and contradictory information when resolving organisational problems
Strategic Mindset - thinks and plans strategically, focusing on the long-term goals and objectives of the organisation
Tech Savvy - leverages new technology to enhance productivity, improve problem solving, and support business growth
Cultivates Innovation - creates an environment that fosters and nurtures a culture of creativity which drives success
Drives Engagement - inspires, motivates and empowers individuals to go above and beyond for the benefit of the team and the organisation

descriptions.title: Data & AI Engineer (JHB Hybrid)
descriptions.description:
Data & AI Engineer (JHB Hybrid)
Datafin
R Undisclosed
Permanent Senior position
Johannesburg
Posted 21 Sep 2026 by Datafin
Expires in 20 days
Job 2645359 - Ref 2609321
Save
Apply Now
About the position
ENVIRONMENT:
A provider of tailored Financial Solutions seeks a Data & AI Engineer to build, maintain, and improve reliable pipelines and curated datasets that feed the company’s analytics, reporting, and AI workloads, and you will help run the governed in-house AI platform that sits on top of them. This is one combined role, not a Data Engineer with an AI paragraph bolted on. Data flows from SQL Server and Azure SQL sources into Fabric, through bronze, silver, and gold layers, and out to the semantic, reporting, and AI consumption layers the business depends on. Expect the work to sit at roughly two-thirds Data Engineering and one-third applied AI in the first year, shifting further towards AI as adoption grows. Both halves run inside the same established standards, which cover metadata-driven, incremental, idempotent ELT, source control, gated deployment, and human review of anything AI-generated. You will grow into full ownership of production data and AI assets end-to-end: build it, document it, support it.
DUTIES:
Data Engineering: Governed pipelines and the estate -
Develop and maintain batch and incremental ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver trusted datasets across our SQL Server / Azure SQL / Microsoft Fabric estate.
Write and optimise T-SQL transformation logic, stored procedures, views, and reconciliation queries, following our standards (CTEs over subqueries, idempotent and metadata-driven patterns).
Build and maintain Fabric pipelines, Dataflow Gen2 flows, and Lakehouse / Warehouse data assets.
Support data modelling: dimensional models, medallion (bronze / silver / gold) layer design, partitioning, and performance optimisation for analytics workloads.
Operate the estate: orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, logging, alerting, and methodical incident resolution for data jobs and platform processes.
Implement data validation, reconciliation, row-count and parity checks so reporting outputs can be trusted and prove it with evidence.
Applied AI: The governed AI platform -
Build and maintain the curated, documented datasets, retrieval indexes, and interfaces that governed AI platform and AI-assisted use cases consume.
Help run the in-house AI platform: content ingestion, indexing, configuration, access control, and routine health checks.
Develop Python automation for AI workloads, covering data preparation, embedding and indexing jobs, evaluation harnesses, and approved API integrations.
Build and evaluate AI use cases such as search, summarisation, classification, extraction, and workflow automation, measuring each against defined success criteria with human-review checkpoints built in.
Enforce data minimisation and anonymisation on every AI path: no personal information, credentials, or production data into unapproved tools, and no uncontrolled egress of data.
Record AI evaluation evidence, including what was tested, what the model produced, what a human reviewer changed, and why, so that AI-assisted output stays traceable and auditable.
Shared: Governance, delivery, and documentation -
Work the governed delivery flow: Git / Azure DevOps source control, feature branches, peer-reviewed pull requests, and gated environment promotion (Dev ? UAT ? production).
Produce and maintain documentation: pipeline design notes, source-to-target mappings, runbooks, AI use-case and configuration notes, and support procedures.
Collaborate with Analysts, the Head of Data & AI, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into governed, supportable data assets, without business logic drifting into unmanaged reports.
What you’ll work with –
Azure SQL and on-premises SQL Server, which form the core transactional and reporting estate.
The wider Fabric surface, including mirroring and CDC ingestion, deployment pipelines, and capacity management.
Python for transformation, automation, and tooling; DAX exposure on the BI side.
Azure DevOps for repos, boards, CI/CD pipelines, and gated deployments.
Power BI and SSRS as the consumption layer you feed.
The governed in-house AI platform, which covers agent tooling, retrieval and indexing, and the controls that make it safe to use on sensitive data. You will help run it, not just use it.
AI-assisted engineering under policy, meaning sanitised inputs, human review of generated code, and traceable output. It is how the whole team works, and how you will work too.
Evaluation and human-review workflows, which are how we decide whether an AI output is good enough to use and how that decision is evidenced.
REQUIREMENTS:
Minimum 1-year hands-on experience in Data Engineering, ETL / ELT, analytics engineering, database development, applied AI, or a closely related production-oriented role.
Solid SQL Server and T-SQL. You should be confident with joins, aggregations, CTEs, and multi-step transformation logic, and able to debug and reason about query performance.
Demonstrable Microsoft Fabric experience. You have built, supported, or substantially prototyped at least one of the following: a Fabric pipeline, a Lakehouse or Warehouse solution, a Dataflow Gen2 flow, or a Fabric notebook. Work, internship, or serious project evidence all count.
Understanding of data warehousing and pipeline design concepts (staging, incremental loads, dimensional modelling).
Working Python. You can read, write, and modify scripts for data preparation, automation, and integration, because the AI half of the role runs on it.
Practical, sceptical familiarity with modern AI tooling. You have used LLM or AI-assisted tools on real work and can explain where they got things wrong, not just that they were useful. No formal Machine-Learning or Data-Science background is required.
Familiarity with source control (Git or similar) and structured, reviewed ways of releasing changes.
Genuine care for data quality, security, least privilege, and confidentiality, including the discipline never to put sensitive data into an unapproved tool.
Advantageous –
Python or PySpark depth for data transformation at scale.
Dataflow Gen2, mirroring / CDC, and Fabric deployment pipelines.
Power BI semantic model and DirectLake awareness; SSRS report development.
Experience with APIs, file feeds, or enterprise source systems.
Retrieval-augmented generation, vector or semantic search, and embedding concepts.
Azure AI services, prompt and evaluation frameworks, agent tooling, or MLOps exposure.
DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate) or another relevant Microsoft certification. These are valued rather than required and are achievable after appointment.
Relevant qualification (Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related) or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in a regulated financial-services or similarly controlled environment.
ATTRIBUTES:
You want to learn, so you ask good questions, absorb feedback, and close the loop.
You verify before you trust, and that includes AI output above all.
You take ownership end-to-end: build it, document it, support it.
You have a quality mindset, so you check your work and raise issues early rather than hoping.
You are comfortable with sensitive data and disciplined governance; process is a feature to you, not friction.
You keep composure in a delivery-focused environment and communicate honestly about progress and blockers.
Integrity and values, with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.
Attention to detail and a results-driven quality mindset.
Strong problem-solving; composure in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.
Works well in a team and independently; communicates openly.
Growth mindset, actively wanting to learn and develop

AVEVA PI:

Advanced ML:

We’re looking for a talented SQL / C# Specialist to join a dynamic Business Intelligence Team and play a hands-on role in developing, maintaining and evolving the data solutions that power a leading supply chain and logistics environment.

You’ll work across SQL, C#, ETL, reporting, APIs, data analytics and emerging AI capabilities — helping transform data into actionable intelligence for both internal teams and customers.

OWN & EVOLVE INTEGRATIONS

TURN DATA INTO INSIGHT

Contribute to advanced data analytics and proactive insight models.
Help transform complex datasets into information that supports better business and customer decisions.
Explore opportunities to use AI and emerging technologies to unlock additional value from data.
PROTECT DATA & MAINTAIN QUALITY

Ensure data is accurate, complete, reliable and appropriately governed.

Participate in testing and quality assurance of new and enhanced solutions.
SHARE KNOWLEDGE
Create technical specifications and supporting documentation.
Participate in requirements gathering and solution design.
Share technical knowledge and best practices with the wider team.
Translate complex technical concepts into language that business stakeholders can understand.

THE SKILLS THAT WILL SET YOU APART
We're looking for someone who is:
Analytical – You enjoy digging into data and finding the story behind it.
Innovative – You constantly look for smarter ways to solve problems.
A problem solver – Complex technical challenges energise you rather than frustrate you.
Results driven – You take ownership and see solutions through to completion.
A strong communicator – You can comfortably translate between technical and business language.
A team player – You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others grow.
Detail focused – You understand that accuracy matters when working with mission-critical data.

THE FUTURE OF DATA IS ALREADY HERE
This role isn't only about maintaining existing systems.
You'll have the opportunity to explore AI, advanced analytics and intelligent data solutions that can create meaningful insights for the business and its customers.
We want someone who is curious about what technology can do next — and who wants to be part of making it happen.

If you're ready to move beyond simply writing SQL queries and maintaining code, this is an opportunity to work across a broader technology ecosystem where your expertise can influence:
DATA ? INTEGRATIONS ? ANALYTICS ? AUTOMATION ? AI ? BUSINESS INSIGHT
You'll be working closely with the BI Manager and wider team in an environment where your technical contribution can directly support operational efficiency and business growth.
READY TO MAKE DATA WORK SMARTER?
If you're a SQL / C# Specialist who loves technology, thrives on solving complex problems and wants to work at the intersection of data, integrations, analytics and AI, we'd love to hear from you.
Bring your technical expertise. Bring your curiosity. Bring your ideas.
Let's turn data into something that drives the business forward.

You will act as the crucial Level 2 bridge within the team, handling routine to intermediate SQL Server DBA tasks, while stepping over to assist with general IT infrastructure, backups, and user management when database duties are complete. Identity & Access Management: Administer user provisioning, group policies, and permissions within Active Directory (AD) and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
General IT Operations: Provide responsive support for general infrastructure tickets, system health checks, and server environment troubleshooting.

Core Experience: Solid foundational-to-intermediate experience as a SQL Database Administrator (DBA) combined with hands-on systems/infrastructure administration background.

Proven experience with SQL Server maintenance plans, backups, restores, and database relocations.
Practical capability in performance monitoring and query troubleshooting (expert-level DBA optimization is not required; practical, operational competence is the priority).

Hands-on experience configuring and managing backup solutions (specifically Veeam and/or Commvault).
Working knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID (user lifecycles, group assignments, permissions).

Ensure every task, decision and risk has a named owner and keep all planning documents coherent with the plan of record.

JOIN the team of an Online Gaming Group seeking to fill the hands-on technical role of an AI Architect/ Engineer. You will serve as one of the site’s most senior individual technical contributors including to its AI-augmented engineering model. The role exists because the transformation the site has committed to, rebuilding how software is specified, written, tested and released around AI assistance, requires deep hands-on engineering ownership that cannot be delivered from a line management position and cannot be bought in as advisory.
DUTIES:
AI Engineering Harnesses:
Accountable for the design, build, operation and lifecycle of the internal harnesses that make AI-assisted Engineering safe and repeatable: agent and assistant scaffolding, repository and domain context layers, prompt and workflow libraries, evaluation harnesses, regression and guardrail suites, and the integration of these into the Developer toolchain and CI/CD pipeline.
Decide on the technical design and implementation of these systems.
AI adoption in delivery:
Accountable for ensuring AI augmentation actually lands in the delivery teams: reference implementations, integration patterns per stack, Developer enablement, and removal of the technical obstacles that stall adoption.
Work through Heads of Engineering and Engineering Managers, who retain accountability for their teams’ delivery outcomes.
Domain and technical depth:
Accountable for holding sufficient depth in business domains — player journey, account and wallet, bonusing and promotions, game integration, payments, responsible gambling controls, regulatory reporting — to judge where AI assistance is safe, where it is not, and what a correct output looks like.
Own the domain context and knowledge artefacts on which AI-assisted work depends.
Technical standards and architecture practice:
Accountable for Engineering standards governing AI-assisted development: code provenance and attribution, review obligations for generated code, licensing and IP hygiene, secure coding under assistance, and the definition of done for AI-assisted change.
Set these standards within the group reference architecture and recommends changes to it where augmentation requires them.
Engineering telemetry and measurement:
Accountable for the technical instrumentation that makes engineering performance observable, delivery, quality and flow telemetry, and the pipelines and analysis layers that turn it into decision-grade evidence for the Managing Director and group stakeholders.
Determine the technical implementation; the measurement framework and its interpretation are agreed with the Managing Director and Heads of Engineering.
Technical evaluation and vendor assessment:
Accountable for the technical evaluation of AI platforms, models, tooling and third-party services proposed for engineering use, including capability benchmarking against workloads, security and data-handling posture, cost model and exit risk.
Recommend to the Managing Director, who holds selection and contracting authority.
Technical leadership without authority:
Accountable for raising the technical ceiling of the engineering organisation: mentoring Senior and Lead Engineers, leading design and architecture review, setting the standard for engineering craft, and building the internal advocacy that carries the augmentation model past initial resistance.
Hold no line authority over any Engineer.
Prototyping and technical risk reduction:
Accountable for de-risking novel technical initiatives ahead of committed delivery through working prototypes and spikes, and for producing a clear, evidenced recommendation to proceed, adapt or stop.

Qualifications –
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering or a related field.
Experience/Skills -
10+ Years in Software Engineering, with a sustained record of hands-on delivery at senior or staff-plus level.
Demonstrated ownership of platform, tooling or Developer-experience systems used across an engineering organisation of comparable scale.
Practical, shipped experience applying AI or Machine Learning to engineering workflows
Evidence of technical leadership without line authority across multiple teams.
Delivery accountability in a regulated, consumer-facing, high-availability environment (advantageous).

About the position
THE ROLE
The Senior Agentic Software Engineer delivers secure, scalable and production-ready software using AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices. Work as a human-in-the-loop engineer, directing and validating AI development agents while applying strong engineering judgement across the full software stack.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
AI-ACCELERATED ENGINEERING
Deliver enterprise-grade software using the client's enterprise AI platform, GitHub Copilot, Claude and similar tools. Direct AI agents using user stories, Figma designs, business rules, design-system components and engineering standards. Refine AI Skills, markdown instruction files, prompts, workflows and guardrails to improve quality, consistency and delivery velocity. Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs rather than accepting them at face value.
FULL-STACK DELIVERY
Design, build and maintain modern frontend experiences, mobile applications, backend services, APIs, integration services, cloud-native components and persistence layers. Move between frontend, backend and platform concerns according to delivery priorities and work across frameworks and languages rather than being constrained by a single technology ecosystem.
ARCHITECTURE  QUALITY
Contribute to technical decisions and review architecture and implementation choices proposed by AI agents. Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, observable and performant. Apply the same engineering standards to AI-generated code as human-written software, while identifying technical debt, architectural drift and quality risks early.
HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP ASSURANCE
Own engineering quality across security and secure coding, performance, reliability, maintainability, accessibility, observability, automated testing, scalability, CI/CD, DevSecOps and technical debt management. Use delivery feedback to improve Skills and instruction files and help establish Agentic Engineering practices that can scale across the programme.
CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
Build reusable AI-enabled engineering capabilities that reduce repetitive work and improve future delivery cycles. Translate engineering standards, coding conventions and security requirements into reusable agent guidance. Contribute to operating practices that make Agentic Engineering a scalable way of working across the programme.
SUCCESS OUTCOMES
Deliver more business value through AI-enabled engineering than traditional development approaches without compromising enterprise quality. Learn and become productive in new frameworks, languages and platforms quickly. Improve the quality and effectiveness of the AI engineering ecosystem over time, while consistently delivering secure, scalable, maintainable and production-ready software.
MINDSET
Work as an AI-native engineer who uses AI as a productivity accelerator while remaining accountable for engineering outcomes. Be framework agnostic, able to move between technologies and become productive quickly as the ecosystem changes. Think beyond individual features to understand the wider system, question agent output, validate assumptions and know when generated code is not good enough.
DELIVERY STANDARDS
Treat security, quality, maintainability, testing and performance as non-negotiable. Ensure solutions are observable and resilient, and use engineering feedback to continuously improve the way software is delivered. Share knowledge and good practices with peers and help raise team standards.
EXPERIENCE
Typically 4-8 years of professional software engineering experience, with a clear trajectory toward senior-level capability and proven experience contributing to complex, enterprise-grade software products. Strong full-stack engineering capability across frontend, backend, APIs, cloud services and data, with a solid understanding of distributed systems, API-driven architectures and modern application architecture.
MOBILE  CROSS-PLATFORM
Commercial experience with modern cross-platform mobile engineering. Experience with React Native and/or Flutter is strongly preferred. Experience with .NET MAUI, Swift, Kotlin or Ionic is advantageous. Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar frameworks quickly and make sound implementation decisions within them.
AI  AGENTIC ENGINEERING
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude or equivalent enterprise platforms. Experience using AI agents for software engineering tasks, including personal projects, and exposure to creating or refining prompts, markdown instruction files or AI-assisted engineering workflows. Understanding how context, instructions, examples and feedback loops influence agent quality, with the ability to identify incorrect assumptions, insecure implementations and superficially plausible but incorrect code.
TECHNICAL EXCELLENCE
Working knowledge of software architecture, secure software development, SOLID principles, performance engineering, design patterns, automated testing/TDD, domain-driven design, CI/CD, API design, DevSecOps, distributed systems, observability, cloud-native engineering, accessibility, code quality and technical debt management.
MINDSET
AI-native and framework agnostic, using AI as a productivity accelerator while remaining accountable for engineering outcomes. A systems thinker who understands how components fit together, treats security, quality, maintainability, testing and performance as non-negotiable, questions agent output and validates assumptions. Continuously learns, experiments and converts expertise into reusable Skills, instructions and patterns that benefit the wider team. Comfortable with ambiguity as technologies and approaches evolve.
SOFTWARE ENGINEERING ENVIRONMENT
Experience working effectively in complex environments with evolving requirements and technology choices, reasoning from engineering principles rather than relying exclusively on framework-specific knowledge.
ENGINEERING JUDGEMENT
Ability to review AI-generated code critically, identify failure modes and make sound implementation decisions within unfamiliar frameworks. Able to spot technical debt, architectural drift and quality risks early.
ADDITIONAL CAPABILITY
Ability to work across frameworks and languages rather than being constrained by a single technology ecosystem. Experience with established design-system components and engineering patterns is relevant. Contribute to technical decisions with support from senior engineers where needed, while owning the quality of AI-generated solutions.
CORE ENGINEERING AREAS
Software architecture, secure software development, SOLID principles, performance engineering, design patterns, automated testing/TDD, domain-driven design, CI/CD, API design, DevSecOps, distributed systems, observability, cloud-native engineering, accessibility, code quality and technical debt management.
DOMAIN  ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE
Digital banking is preferred, while strong enterprise engineering experience is essential. Banking or broader financial services experience is a nice to have, as is experience with enterprise design systems and reusable UI component libraries.
PRODUCT  DELIVERY
Experience translating Figma designs and product requirements into production software is beneficial. Experience in product-led, agile or large-scale digital transformation programmes is also advantageous. Early experience mentoring junior developers or reviewing code across a team is useful, as is exposure to engineering standards, governance practices or developer enablement work.
SUCCESS
Deliver more business value through AI-enabled engineering without compromising enterprise quality. Learn and become productive in new frameworks, languages and platforms quickly. Improve the quality and effectiveness of the AI engineering ecosystem over time while exercising strong engineering judgement when validating AI-generated designs and code.
Consistently deliver secure, scalable, maintainable and production-ready software. Grow Agentic Engineering capability and support the development of peers. Use code review and delivery feedback to improve Skills, instruction files and engineering practices with each iteration, identifying where AI is effective, where human intervention is needed and where workflows can be refined.
ROLE CONTEXT
This is not a traditional software engineering position or a conventional AI Engineer role. The Senior Agentic Software Engineer uses AI to meaningfully accelerate engineering throughput while protecting the standards expected of enterprise-grade banking software. Success is measured by business outcomes, delivery quality and the engineer's ability to improve the AI-enabled delivery system.
The role forms part of a pioneering engineering capability working alongside traditional engineering teams. The practices established by the group are intended to influence how software engineering is performed across the programme. The role suits engineers with strong engineering foundations, genuine curiosity about AI-assisted development, broad technical awareness and the ambition to grow their craft alongside the evolution of software engineering.
WHAT MAKES THE ROLE DIFFERENT
The role focuses on directing, validating and continuously improving autonomous or semi-autonomous AI software development agents through human engineering judgement. Technology choices will continue to evolve, so success depends on strong engineering fundamentals, a growing systems mindset and the ability to learn and apply new technologies quickly.
WORKING APPROACH
Use complete product inputs such as user stories, Figma designs, business rules, design-system components and engineering standards to guide AI-assisted delivery. Balance delivery speed with the security, performance, reliability, maintainability, accessibility, observability, scalability and testing standards expected of enterprise software.
COLLABORATION  GROWTH
Share knowledge and good practices with peers and support the development of others. Convert personal expertise into reusable Skills, instructions and patterns that benefit the wider team. Contribute to establishing engineering practices that scale across the programme and help shape the emerging standard for software delivery.

THIS ISN'T JUST ABOUT WRITING CODE
You'll work with AI as your engineering partner.

Direct AI agents to build real software
Turn user stories, Figma designs and business rules into working solutions

Continuously improve how AI contributes to software delivery
The AI writes code. You provide the engineering judgement.

Frontend applications
Mobile and cross-platform experiences
Backend services
APIs and integrations
Cloud-native platforms
Data and persistence layers
CI/CD and DevSecOps
Automated testing
Observability and performance
The technology landscape will evolve, so we're looking for engineers who can learn fast, adapt quickly and aren't tied to a single framework or language.
THE AGENTIC ENGINEERING MINDSET
We're looking for engineers who are:
AI-NATIVE
You know how to use AI to dramatically increase your productivity — without outsourcing your engineering judgement.
CURIOUS
You enjoy experimenting with new tools, frameworks and ways of building software.
FRAMEWORK-AGNOSTIC
React Native today? Flutter tomorrow? .NET MAUI next? You can adapt.
CONSTRUCTIVELY SCEPTICAL
AI-generated code isn't automatically good code. You know how to question it, test it and improve it.
SYSTEMS-THINKING
You understand how individual components fit into larger, complex enterprise systems.
QUALITY-OBSESSED
Security, scalability, performance, testing and maintainability aren't optional extras.
CONTINUOUSLY LEARNING
You're excited about where software engineering is heading — and want to help shape it.
RequirementsWHAT YOU'LL BRING
We're looking for 4–8 years of professional software engineering experience, with strong foundations and a clear trajectory toward senior-level capability.
You'll ideally have:
Strong full-stack software engineering experience
Experience delivering complex enterprise applications
Frontend, backend, API and cloud experience
Understanding of distributed systems and modern application architecture
Strong software design and engineering principles
Commercial mobile/cross-platform development experience
React Native and/or Flutter experience highly advantageous
Experience with .NET MAUI, Swift, Kotlin or Ionic advantageous
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools
Exposure to AI agents, prompts, instruction files or AI engineering workflows
The ability to recognise when AI-generated code is incorrect, insecure or poorly designed
ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE STILL MATTERS
AI may accelerate development — but engineering standards don't change.
You'll be expected to understand and apply:
Software Architecture • Secure Coding • SOLID • Design Patterns • TDD • DDD • API Design • CI/CD • DevSecOps • Distributed Systems • Cloud-Native Engineering • Observability • Performance • Accessibility • Technical Debt Management
WHY THIS ROLE?
Because software engineering is changing.
This isn't a traditional Software Engineer role — and it isn't simply an AI Engineer role either.
It's a role for engineers who want to sit at the intersection of software engineering and agentic AI.
You'll have the opportunity to:
Accelerate how software is built
Work directly with AI development agents
Develop next-generation engineering practices
Influence how AI is used across enterprise delivery
Work across evolving technologies and frameworks
Build production-grade enterprise software
Help shape the future of software engineering
The programme's goal is to establish a new standard for AI-enabled software delivery, and you'll be part of building that capability.
Ready to engineer what comes next?

About the position
ROLE
The Senior Security Architect is accountable for the end-to-end security architecture of a customer-facing mobile banking platform. The role defines, governs, and continuously evolves security across mobile applications, APIs, identity platforms, cloud infrastructure, backend services, shared platforms, and DevSecOps delivery pipelines.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Own the end-to-end security architecture and define security across mobile apps, APIs, identity platforms, cloud infrastructure, backend services, shared platforms, and DevSecOps pipelines.
Architect customer authentication using PIN, biometrics, device-bound cryptographic keys, risk context, and transaction-level authorisation. Govern secure use of mobile keystores.
Own OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, PKCE, secure token storage, token rotation, and device-bound session models. Define API, Backend-for-Frontend, and service security patterns aligned to Zero Trust principles.
Lead threat modelling across onboarding, authentication, payments, card management, account servicing, and other sensitive customer journeys. Translate threats into architecture patterns, security controls, security requirements, and architecture decision records.
Embed Security-by-Design into architecture, release governance, and delivery assurance. Define DevSecOps guardrails including SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secrets management, container scanning, IaC security, and secure release gates.
Support penetration testing, vulnerability remediation, incident readiness, and cyber-resilience initiatives. Embed Privacy-by-Design, consent management, secure data processing, retention, and data lifecycle controls.
Act as a security design authority across delivery squads, engineering, product, risk, and compliance functions. Balance security, customer experience, operational resilience, and delivery velocity.
Define mobile fraud prevention architecture, device binding, transaction risk scoring, adaptive authentication, API abuse prevention, and anomaly detection.
Define cloud-native security controls for containerized workloads, Kubernetes, service meshes, and cloud services. Establish cyber-resilience architecture covering disaster recovery, ransomware resilience, backup integrity, and business continuity.
Define security monitoring architecture integrating SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, fraud monitoring, audit logging, and incident response workflows.
Assess and govern third-party, fintech, SaaS, payment, and partner integrations. Define and govern AI and agentic platform security controls including model security, prompt injection prevention, data leakage protection, secure retrieval, authorisation, auditability, and responsible AI guardrails.
Lead security architecture reviews and risk assessments across Mobile, Web, Backend, Data, AI, Cloud, Infrastructure, DevOps, Testing, and Shared Platform domains. Act as the final security architecture authority for production releases and significant design changes.
EXPERIENCE  CAPABILITY
Senior-level security architecture experience in digital banking, payments, fintech, financial services, or other regulated customer-facing digital platforms.
Strong hands-on understanding of mobile security, API security, identity, cryptography, cloud security, DevSecOps, platform security, fraud controls, and operational resilience.
Ability to translate business risks and threat scenarios into pragmatic architecture decisions, technical controls, delivery guardrails, and measurable security requirements.
Proven ability to work across engineering, product, architecture, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, fraud, privacy, operations, and executive stakeholders. Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences.
CORE TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
Mobile security: iOS and Android application security, secure storage, platform security models, jailbreak/root detection, hardening, secure local data handling, mobile threat defence, and application shielding.
Authentication: PIN-based authentication, biometrics, device-bound credentials, step-up authentication, adaptive authentication, risk-based authentication, and transaction-level authorisation.
Identity and access: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, PKCE, secure token handling, session management, token rotation, device-bound sessions, and delegated authorisation.
Cryptography: cryptographic key lifecycle management, HSM integration, enterprise key vaults, hardware-backed keystores, secure enclave usage, signing, encryption, certificate lifecycle, and cryptographic standards.
API and platform security: API gateway security, BFF security, Zero Trust, rate limiting, bot protection, API abuse prevention, schema validation, threat protection, mTLS, and certificate pinning.
Fraud and risk: device binding, device attestation, account takeover prevention, transaction risk scoring, behavioural analytics, fraud platform integration, and high-risk transaction controls.
DevSecOps: SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secret scanning, container scanning, IaC scanning, secure release gates, signed artefacts, SBOM, supply chain security, and secure build pipelines.
Cloud and infrastructure: cloud security architecture across Azure, AWS, or GCP, Kubernetes security, container security, service mesh security, workload identity, network security, and platform resilience.
Threat and assurance: threat modelling, secure design reviews, security NFRs, penetration testing support, vulnerability remediation, incident readiness, security monitoring, logging, and forensic readiness.
AI security: AI and agentic platform security, secure retrieval patterns, prompt injection controls, data leakage prevention, model access control, responsible AI guardrails, and AI auditability.
REGULATORY, STANDARDS  GOVERNANCE
Ensure compliance with applicable banking, payments, cyber, and data protection regulations, including POPIA, PCI DSS, SARB, FSCA guidance, and related organisational security policies.
Align security architecture with recognised standards and frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, OWASP MASVS, OWASP ASVS, OWASP API Security Top 10, CIS benchmarks, and Zero Trust architecture principles.
Define, review, and govern security architecture artefacts including HLDs, LLDs, architecture decision records, threat models, security NFRs, risk acceptances, and exception records.
Partner with risk, fraud, compliance, privacy, legal, and operational resilience teams to ensure governance, auditability, and regulatory assurance.
ARCHITECTURE ARTEFACTS
Security architecture vision, principles, patterns, and guardrails. Mobile authentication architecture, device binding models, session management, and transaction authorisation patterns.
Threat models for onboarding, login, payments, card servicing, profile changes, and sensitive journeys. Security NFRs, secure coding standards, secure integration patterns, and technical control requirements.
Cryptography and key management architecture, including keystores, HSMs, key vaults, certificates, and signing models. API security architecture, BFF security patterns, Zero Trust controls, and API abuse prevention models.
DevSecOps control architecture, secure pipeline guardrails, release assurance criteria, and supply chain security controls.
Operational security, monitoring, logging, incident readiness, and forensic readiness architecture. AI and agentic platform security architecture patterns for intelligent agents or AI-assisted capabilities.
DESIRED CERTIFICATIONS  KNOWLEDGE
CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, Azure Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent security architecture credentials.
Knowledge of OWASP MASVS, OWASP ASVS, OWASP Mobile Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, NIST, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, POPIA, and banking regulatory expectations.
Exposure to mobile fraud prevention, digital identity, payment security, hardware-backed cryptography, cloud-native security, DevSecOps, and AI security governance.
SUCCESS OUTCOMES
A governed, secure, scalable, and resilient mobile banking platform architecture that supports trusted digital banking at enterprise scale.
Authentication and authorisation models that protect customers while preserving a simple and reliable digital experience.
Security controls embedded early in solution design and automated through delivery pipelines wherever possible.
Clear security decision-making across squads, architecture forums, risk governance, and release assurance processes.
Reduced security, fraud, privacy, and resilience risk across critical customer journeys and platform services.

Job purpose
The Contract Validation Officer’s main responsibility will be to assist the Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Technician from Cape Town and the Project Engineer at East London to perform periodic reviews of all facilities, utilities, systems, and equipment in accordance with cGMP, regulatory requirements, and Kenvue Global Standards.

Requirements Definition

Finalization & Release

Ownership & Accountability —
takes single-point accountability for a product and drives it forward independently, without micromanagement.

confident with P&L/TCO, unit economics, budget variance, and contract and vendor commercials.

fluent written and spoken English; additional languages an advantage given the global footprint.

You will sit with Agile teams and Product Owners across internal and external business units, helping them ship solutions that the business actually needs. Expect SAFe at program level, real dependencies, and teams that are ready to become more self-managing.
What you will do:
·        Facilitate and collaborate between Agile teams and Product Owners of internal and external business units to develop solutions that support business needs.
·        Coach and support the Product Owner, Business Analyst, Architects and delivery teams in effective backlog management, prioritisation, refinement and readiness.
·        Support the team in achieving business objectives by improving planning, flow, collaboration, and visibility of delivery risks and dependencies.
·        Build effective relationships across the team, Product Owner, stakeholders and supporting teams, while promoting transparency around delivery progress, quality, capacity, risks, and dependencies.
·        Exhibit Lean-Agile leadership and servant leadership principles.
·        Monitor and use delivery metrics to identify opportunities to improve flow, predictability, quality, and delivery effectiveness.
·        Help the team focus on daily and sprint goals in the context of Program Increment (PI) Objectives.
·        Teach problem-solving techniques and help teams become self-managing and solution oriented.
·        Facilitate all team ceremonies, including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, Backlog Refinements, Retrospectives, and PI Planning sessions.
·        Eliminate impediments and escalate organisational blockers when necessary.
·        Foster a culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance by coaching and supporting teams in developing effective ways of working.
·        Coordinate inter-team dependencies and represent the team in Scrum of Scrums (SoS) and Agile Release Train (ART) activities.
·        Help the team understand estimation techniques and value-based prioritisation.
RequirementsWhat you bring:
·        Degree or Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
·        Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or an equivalent Agile certification.
·        8+ years as a Scrum Master or related experience.
·        Proven experience leading Agile teams in complex digital transformation environments.
·        Strong practical experience with Scrum, Kanban, SAFe and Lean-Agile principles.
·        Experience facilitating continuous improvement through delivery metrics, team feedback and empirical data.
·        Experience working with distributed, hybrid and cross-functional teams.
·        Good understanding of software development lifecycles, technical delivery practices, dependencies, risks and delivery constraints.
·        Proficiency with Agile delivery and collaboration tools such as Jira, Microsoft 365, Teams, Miro, Lucidchart and similar applications.
·        Strong understanding of Agile principles, flow, value delivery and continuous improvement.
·        Sufficient technical understanding to engage effectively with Developers, Architects, BAs, QA and other technical stakeholders, including basic knowledge of APIs, integrations, architecture and modern software development practices.
·        Demonstrated interest in emerging technologies, AI-enabled ways of working and evolving Agile delivery practices.
How you show up:
·        Strong servant leadership and stakeholder engagement, with the ability to build trust and foster collaboration across teams and organisational levels.
·        Excellent facilitation, coaching, mentoring and conflict-resolution skills, so teams become increasingly self-managing.
·        Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, focused on root causes and sustainable solutions.
·        Highly self-motivated, adaptable, resilient and resourceful in complex, changing environments.
·        Strong verbal and written communication.
·        Able to operate in fast-paced, complex technology delivery environments and to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
·        Strong grasp of Agile metrics, flow, capacity, dependencies, value streams and continuous improvement, and the ability to use data to spot bottlenecks and delivery risks.
·        You encourage teams to use appropriate automation, AI-assisted tools and data-driven insights where these improve effectiveness and outcomes.
·        A data-driven mindset: you can interpret and communicate insights from dashboards, analytics and predictive reporting.
·        Able to support organisational and team change linked to new technologies, ways of working and digital transformation.
·        Digital transformation awareness and a continuous improvement mindset.
·        Familiarity with modern software engineering practices and AI-assisted development approaches.
If you want to coach high-performing teams inside a complex financial services and insurance environment, and you already know how to make Scrum, Kanban and SAFe work in the real world, this is the brief.

About the position
Our client, a leading International Logistics company based in Johannesburg, is looking to fill the position of Overland Logistics Manager.
Purpose of the Role:
Reporting to the General Manager. The Logistics Manager is responsible for planning, directing, and controlling all warehouse and distribution operations within a 3PL environment to ensure efficient, safe, compliant, and cost-effective service delivery to clients. The role oversees inventory management, warehousing, transport coordination, customer service, staff leadership, and continuous improvement to meet contractual service levels and profitability targets. The incumbent is accountable for maintaining high standards in operational execution, client satisfaction, people management, statutory compliance, and performance reporting across the warehouse and distribution function.
Key Responsibilities:
Operational Management:
Manage the day-to-day operations of the warehouse and distribution function.
Ensure inbound, storage, inventory control, order picking, packing, dispatch, and outbound distribution activities are executed efficiently.
Oversee route planning, load optimisation, vehicle utilisation, and delivery scheduling in line with customer requirements.
Ensure all client SLAs, KPIs, and operational targets are achieved.
Monitor productivity, turnaround times, stock accuracy, on-time dispatch, and delivery performance.
Coordinate with clients, transporters, suppliers, and internal departments to ensure seamless service delivery.
Drive execution consistency across receiving, put-away, replenishment, picking, staging, dispatch, and proof of delivery processes.
Warehouse Management:
Ensure warehouse layout, capacity utilisation, and storage methods support operational efficiency and stock integrity.
Manage stock handling processes to minimise damages, losses, and shrinkage.
Oversee cycle counts, stock takes, reconciliations, and inventory investigations.
Ensure adherence to FIFO/FEFO and product-specific storage requirements where applicable.
Maintain strong housekeeping and warehouse organisation standards.
Distribution and Transport Coordination:
Coordinate vehicle scheduling and delivery planning to achieve on-time and in-full (OTIF) performance.
Ensure fleet or subcontractor performance is monitored and managed effectively.
Manage transport costs, fuel usage, route efficiency, and service provider performance.
Resolve delivery issues, route deviations, claims, and customer escalations promptly.
Ensure proof of delivery and delivery exception management processes are controlled.
Client and Customer Service Management:
Serve as the primary operational contact for client-related logistics matters.
Build strong relationships with clients through regular communication and operational reviews.
Ensure client reporting is accurate, timely, and action oriented.
Address service failures and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
Support contract implementation, new business onboarding, and operational start-ups.
Financial and Cost Management:
Manage warehouse and distribution costs in line with budget.
Monitor labour costs, overtime, transport spend, damages, claims, and consumables.
Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising service or compliance.
Support budget preparation, monthly forecasting, variance analysis and monthly flash.
Ensure operational activities contribute to margin protection and profitability.
People Management:
Lead, coach, and develop warehouse and distribution teams to achieve operational excellence.
Manage workforce planning, staffing levels, shift structures, attendance, discipline, and performance.
Conduct performance reviews and ensure training and development needs are addressed.
Drive a culture of accountability, teamwork, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

About the position
South African Sugarcane Research Institute (SASRI)
a division of the South African Sugar Association (SASA) has a permanent vacancy for a
Plant Breeder - Irrigated Region
, at their
SASRI Pongola Research Station
, based in
Pongola.
The opportunity
Irrigated sugarcane growers in Pongola, Komatipoort, Malelane and beyond rely on varieties bred for their conditions. We are looking for a Plant Breeder to lead SASRI's irrigated breeding programme from our Pongola Research Station, close to the trials, the fields and the growers the work is for.
You will take ownership of the programme that develops SASRI's "N" varieties, bred specifically for irrigated production. These varieties are grown across South Africa's irrigated region and licensed to sugarcane estates elsewhere in sub-Saharan Africa, so your work will reach well beyond our borders.
This is a hands-on, field-based role with real influence. The decisions you help make about which varieties move forward will shape what growers plant for years to come.
About SASRI
The South African Sugarcane Research Institute (SASRI) is the research division of the South African Sugar Association (SASA). Our Breeding and Field Resource Unit develops high-yielding, pest- and disease-resistant sugarcane varieties for each of the industry's growing regions, combining field selection with complementary research.
What you'll do
Lead the irrigated breeding programme
Manage selection activities and variety trials at the Pongola and Komatipoort research stations, at grower sites across the irrigated region, and at the newly established trials on Eswatini sugar estates.
Plan, place and evaluate selection trials, making sure they are well designed and produce reliable data.
Analyse trial results, document how each genotype performs, and make sound recommendations on which varieties to advance and release.
Manage seedcane and seedcane bulking for the programme.
Lead and develop the Pongola team
Supervise, mentor and support the Selection Officer and selection staff based at Pongola.
Set clear standards for trial planning, implementation and data quality.
Work closely with growers and colleagues
Coordinate the trial network with Research Station Managers.
Engage regularly with Extension specialists and growers, so that what we breed reflects what growers need.
Work with the breeding team at Mount Edgecombe and contribute to SASRI's wider breeding programme.
Look for new technologies and methods that make the programme more efficient.
Manage, report and share
Manage project budgets and allocate resources to meet programme goals.
Share results through reports, peer-reviewed publications and conferences, and connect with the international sugarcane breeding community.
What you'll bring
Essential
A PhD in Plant Breeding and Genetics, Quantitative Genetics or a related field.
Practical experience in a plant breeding programme, including running field trials.
A strong grounding in field breeding methods, experimental design and the statistical analysis of trial data.
Confidence with databases, spreadsheets and statistical software.
Experience supervising or leading staff.
A track record of managing projects and meeting milestones.
Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to speak comfortably with scientists and growers alike.
A valid driver's licence and willingness to travel regularly across the irrigated region and to Eswatini.
An advantage
Knowledge of sugarcane, especially sugarcane breeding or production under irrigation.
Experience in a commercial breeding programme.
Experience with multi-environment trials and genotype-by-environment analysis.
Familiarity with quantitative and statistical genetics, selection theory, and family, parent and breeding-value evaluation.
Knowledge of molecular markers, genomic tools or introgression breeding.
Who you are
You are self-motivated, organised and careful with detail. You enjoy fieldwork and practical problem-solving, and you are comfortable working independently at a regional station while staying closely connected to a wider team. You build good relationships easily, whether with your own staff, colleagues at head office or growers in the field.
Why join us
Lead a programme whose results growers see directly in their fields.
Build and guide your own team at Pongola.
Join a research institute with a long record in sugarcane breeding, and colleagues who are generous with their expertise.
SASRI offers a market related package and relocation support to the selected applicant.
Our recruitment process includes formal assessments of cognitive ability and behavioural style, carried out by an internationally recognised assessment provider.

WHC provides Faculty with a legal framework within which to operate the research and other activities necessary to support its academic objectives
In addition, WHC offers a range of products and services to Academics

Our work also stretches to other important infectious diseases

Wits Mycology
Main purpose of the job:
This is a clinically active role with significant responsibility for the day-to-day execution of clinical trial protocols, participant safety, regulatory compliance, and site management
The incumbent will operate under the supervision of the site Principal Investigator(s), manage the study site team (2 Nurses per site) and will work in close collaboration with the wider COMBAT Candida study management group
The post-holder will be expected to demonstrate strong site management skills, robust clinical trial experience, and the capacity to function independently
You will also be expected to contribute to the data analysis and any peer-reviewed publications arising from the study, and to contribute to related sub-studies or projects

Key performance areas:

Prepare for and facilitate external and internal monitoring visits; address queries and CAPAs raised by sponsor monitors or auditors
Participate in the preparation and review of study reports, abstracts, and peer-reviewed manuscripts arising from the COMBAT Candida study
Engage with sub-study or ancillary research projects linked to the main cohort as directed by the Clinical Lead or Chief Investigators
Identify training needs within the site team and coordinate training delivery in liaison with the Trial Management Team e.g. CRF completion training, quality assurance and other study related training

MBBCh/MBChB degree
HPCSA Registration as an independent medical practitioner
Certification in good clinical practice (GCP)

Minimum 2-year’s work experience as a Medical Officer
Proven track record of working in a clinical trial research environment and prior sub-investigator experience on a clinical trial
Experience with electronic data capture (EDC) systems, preferably REDCap

Experience in infectious disease, mycology, or related speciality
Strong scientific writing ability and publication record
Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently under pressure
Able to exercise discretion and independent decision-making
Ability to prioritize own workload, take initiative (pro-active) and work to tight deadlines
Work as part of the multidisciplinary team to ensure good patient care and good quality data

A government entity is hiring a Solutions Architect to lead solution design that fits the enterprise: information architecture, system portfolios and integration, not a design that looks good and breaks the landscape.

You lead the process of developing solutions from predefined processes, guidelines and best practices, so the result fits the enterprise architecture. You know the application portfolio, and you work with Development and Enterprise Architecture so design, architecture and applications stay aligned.
What you will do:
?   Lead the development of solutions based on predefined processes, guidelines and best practices, so the solution fits the enterprise architecture in information architecture, system portfolios and integration requirements.

?   Participate in, and lead when needed, project meetings with the government entity.

?   Convert business requirements into solution designs, with good judgment and a pragmatic eye on constraints.

RequirementsWhat you bring:

?   A tertiary qualification in Computer Science and/or Software Engineering and/or Information Systems and/or Information Technology, and/or a related technical certification in an IT field.

About the position
ENVIRONMENT:
Our client is currently seeking a Senior Power Platform Developer.  This role sits at the point where the Microsoft 365 estate, the Power Platform and conversational AI meet. You will design and build business applications on Power Apps and Power Automate, and you will design and ship the agents that sit on top of them in Copilot Studio. They are looking for someone who thinks in terms of enterprise architecture rather than individual applications. The work involves deciding where a process belongs, which parts of the Microsoft 365 and Azure stack should carry it, how data flows between them, and how the whole thing is governed once it is live. Building the solution is a large part of the job, but so is the reasoning that precedes it. Copilot Studio is a central skillset for this position, not a peripheral one. A meaningful share of their current pipeline work involves agents that act on enterprise data and trigger real business processes, and they need someone who has taken that kind of work into production rather than only through a proof of concept.
DUTIES:
Solution and enterprise architecture
Assess business processes and decide what belongs in the Power Platform, what belongs in Microsoft 365, what
belongs in Azure, and what should not be built at all.
Define environment strategy across development, test and production, including Dataverse provisioning, environment groups and managed environments.
Design the data model, starting with Dataverse tables, relationships, business rules and calculated columns, and
extending to integration with systems of record outside the platform.
Define the security model, covering Dataverse security roles, business units, teams, column level security and
hierarchy security and align it to Entra ID groups.
Set and enforce data loss prevention policies, connector governance and tenant level guardrails, typically through a Centre of Excellence pattern.
Advise clients on licensing and capacity, including the cost implications of Premium connectors, Dataverse storage, Copilot Studio messages and Power Platform requests.
Copilot Studio
Design, build and deploy custom agents in Copilot Studio for internal and client facing use cases.
Author topics and conversational flows and decide deliberately where to use authored topics and where to rely on generative orchestration.
Ground agents in enterprise knowledge, including SharePoint, Dataverse, public and internal websites, and file based sources, and tune retrieval quality rather than accepting the default behaviour.
Build actions that let agents do work rather than only answer questions, using connectors, Power Automate flows, agent flows, custom APIs and Model Context Protocol servers.
Implement authentication correctly, including Entra ID single sign on and user context propagation, so that an agent only ever returns what the requesting user is entitled to see.
Deploy agents across the right channels, most commonly Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, SharePoint and web.
Test, evaluate and improve agent behaviour over time, using analytics, conversation transcripts, escalation rates and topic level performance to drive changes.
Apply responsible AI practice, including scope limits, refusal behaviour, escalation to a human, and clear communication to users about what the agent can and cannot do.
Extend agents into Microsoft 365 Copilot where appropriate, including declarative agents and connected knowledge
Power Apps
Build canvas applications with well-structured Power Fx, reusable components and a considered approach to delegation and performance against large data sources.
Build model driven applications on Dataverse, including forms, views, business process flows and command bar customisation.
Develop custom components with the Power Apps Component Framework where the out of the box controls are not sufficient.
Design interfaces that people will actually use, including responsive layouts, accessibility and offline behaviour where the scenario calls for it.
Power Automate
Build cloud flows for approvals, integration, scheduled processing and event driven automation.
Build desktop flows for robotic process automation against systems that offer no API.
Develop custom connectors for internal and third party APIs.
Apply error handling, retry policy, concurrency control and monitoring, so that failures are visible and recoverable rather than silent.
Microsoft 365 and integration
Integrate solutions with SharePoint Online, Teams, Exchange and OneDrive.
Use Microsoft Graph where the platform connectors fall short.
Integrate with Azure services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus and Azure OpenAI where a requirement exceeds what the platform provides natively.
Application lifecycle management
Manage solutions properly, including managed and unmanaged solution strategy, solution layering and environment variables.
Build deployment pipelines using Power Platform pipelines or Azure DevOps, with source control and automated deployment rather than manual export and import.
Maintain documentation that allows a client team to take ownership after handover.
Leadership
At Lead level, you will additionally own the technical direction of an engagement, review the work of other developers, set standards for the team, and act as the primary technical point of contact for the client.
REQUIREMENTS:
Core skills
Enterprise architecture
Microsoft 365
Microsoft Power Platform
Power Apps, both canvas and model driven
Power Automate, including cloud flows and desktop flows
Copilot Studio, including agent design, knowledge grounding, actions and deployment
Dataverse data modelling and security
Power Fx
Application lifecycle management and CI/CD for the Power Platform
Technologies
Microsoft Power Platform · Power Apps · Power Automate · Copilot Studio · Dataverse · Power Fx · Power Pages · Power BI ·Microsoft 365 · SharePoint Online · Microsoft Teams · Microsoft Graph · Entra ID · Azure Functions · Azure API Management · Azure DevOps · Git · MCP
Nice to have
Experience designing and delivering training, whether formal client enablement sessions, internal upskilling, or
structured handover to a client team at the end of an engagement. This carries real weight for us, because a large part of the value we leave behind is a client team that can operate and extend what they have built.
Relevant Microsoft certifications, for example the Power Platform Solution Architect, Power Platform Developer or Power Platform Functional Consultant tracks.
Experience establishing or running a Power Platform Centre of Excellence.
Experience with Power Pages for external facing portals.
Experience in a consulting or client facing delivery environment.
Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol and with agent patterns outside the Microsoft stack.
Traditional development background, for example C# or TypeScript, for the cases where the platform is not the right answer.
What they look for beyond the technology
The judgement to say when a low code solution is the wrong choice, and the ability to justify that position to a client who may have already decided otherwise.
Clear written communication. Much of the role is remote, and architectural decisions need to survive being read rather than explained in person.
A pragmatic view of AI. Agents are a strong fit for some problems and a poor fit for others, and they would rather hire someone who can tell the difference than someone who applies them everywhere.

Lead

About the position
A well-known international Agricultural / Fertiliser company requires the above to provide timely, reliable, and actionable market intelligence to support the commercial, pricing, planning, and growth decisions across the African fertiliser markets.
Minimum requirements for the role:
A bachelor’s degree in Economics, Agricultural Economics, Finance, Business, Marketing, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred for the role.
Previous experience having worked in market intelligence, market analysis, strategy, commercial analytics, consulting, or commodity research or a related role within the Agricultural / Fertiliser markets, with evidence of managing complex analytical workstreams, is essential for the role.
Previous experience having worked within the fertiliser, phosphates, ammonia, agriculture, or related markets is required; direct African fertiliser-market exposure is strongly preferred.
Previous experience having worked in research, forecasting, competitor analysis, market sizing, pricing analysis, and executive reporting is preferred for the role.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint capability; experience working with Power BI or other data-visualisation tools and market-intelligence platforms is advantageous.
Must be able to build transparent analytical models, test scenarios, interpret incomplete data, and communicate confidence levels and limitations.
Must have strong commercial judgment, strategic thinking, structured problem-solving, and attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal English, executive presentation, and stakeholder-influencing skills.
The successful candidate will be responsible for:
Providing timely, reliable, and actionable market intelligence to support the companies commercial, pricing, planning, and growth decisions across the African Fertiliser markets.
Monitoring regional supply, demand, trade flows, prices, competitor activity, customer and crop-market developments, regulation, logistics constraints, and macroeconomic factors; converting complex information into practical insights, scenarios, forecasts, and recommendations; and maintaining a controlled regional market-intelligence knowledge base.
Supporting market prioritisation, sales and product strategy, annual planning, business cases, partnerships, and investment assessments while remaining appropriately scoped as an Africa-focused manager role rather than a global market-intelligence director position.
Building and maintaining a structured intelligence view of fertiliser markets across priority African countries, including market size, consumption, production, imports, exports, seasonal demand, application trends, distribution channels and key participants.
Monitoring regional and global developments that materially affect Africa, including production outages, capacity additions, trade flows, freight, port constraints, raw-material movements, policy changes, foreign exchange, weather, crop economics and geopolitical developments.
Maintaining regional price series, benchmarks, netback views, freight-adjusted comparisons and historical trend analyses for relevant products and markets.
Developing and updating short- and medium-term scenarios for supply, demand, imports, prices, competitor behaviour and market balances using documented assumptions.
Maintaining profiles of relevant producers, exporters, importers, distributors, blenders and major customers, including product portfolios, capacity, market presence, channels, pricing behaviour, partnerships, strengths and risks.
Conducting market segmentation and opportunity sizing by country, crop, product, customer segment, application, channel and route to market.
Monitoring crop calendars, planted areas, yields, farmer economics, subsidy programmes, fertiliser affordability, nutrient-use patterns and agronomic developments that influence demand.
Coordinating with Agronomy, Product Development, Sales and Marketing to identify product needs, grade opportunities, application trends and market-development priorities.
Assessing demand implications of climate, rainfall, commodity prices, farm economics and changes in agricultural policy.
Providing Africa-focused inputs to annual and long-range marketing and business plans, including key assumptions, country priorities, market risks, growth pools and scenario implications.
Supporting business cases, market-entry assessments, product-development decisions, partnerships, strategic alliances, JVs and downstream opportunities through pre-due-diligence and due-diligence analysis.
Producing recurring and ad hoc reports, executive briefs, presentations, market outlooks and scenario analyses for MMSA and relevant HQ stakeholders.
Maintaining regular working relationships with Commercial, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, Strategy, Agronomy, Product Development, Risk, Legal and Compliance.
Salary package, including benefits, is highly negotiable depending on experience gained.
