About the position
JOB PURPOSE
Apply expert-level forensic accounting and investigative knowledge to lead and take full accountability for complex, high-risk, and precedent-setting forensic investigations, including the gathering, analysis, verification, and interpretation of complex financial evidence, to support law enforcement agencies in the investigation and/or prosecution of serious and complex financial crimes, and to safeguard the institutional credibility and mandate of the Financial Intelligence Centre.
KEY PERFOrMANCE AREAS
Forensic Evidence Data Collection and Analysis
Design and approve investigative strategies and analytical methodologies for complex or novel cases where no standard precedent exists.
Explore and gather key financial intelligence and evidence from relevant information platforms and guide the law enforcement partner with person-of-interest interviews to support evidence production for legal proceedings.
Determine the relevance and completeness of evidence information and/or evidence and ensure that all gaps in information are addressed.
Support data integrity by ensuring that all data is verified within reasonable parameters and line of sight.
Perform relevant calculations in order to produce quality evidence-based information.
Conduct analysis of financial intelligence and evidence within acceptable forensic quality norms required.
Identify and investigate discrepancies, patterns and connections between financial intelligence and evidence information sources to support evidence integrity.
Analyse indicators and typologies associated with relevant financial crimes.
Lead multi agency forensic engagements involving heightened legal, financial, or reputational risk.
Provide authoritative technical resolution on disputed evidentiary, analytical, or methodological matters.
Forensic Evidence Reporting
Assume full technical and professional accountability for the final content, conclusions, and legal defensibility of forensic reports and affidavits for complex matters.
Coordinate the production of forensic reports or affidavits for mandated stakeholders by the agreed due dates and in compliance with relevant legislation, policies, procedures and annual targets.
Contextualise financial information and/or evidence in support of law enforcement efforts by capturing findings and conclusions in the required reporting format and systems and submit investigation outcomes, trends and recommendations as prescribed by relevant policies and procedure.
Summarise and present complex financial information and relevant data in a manner that supports evidence-based products.
Utilise computerised applications such as spreadsheets, databases, or computer models to produce charts and graphics to explain findings.
Provide guidance to Junior Forensic Accountants and Associate Forensic Accountants in producing forensic reports or affidavits.
Review forensic reports by Junior Forensic Accountants and Associate Forensic Accountants and ensure that they comply with agreed standards and support annual targets.
Collaborate with Senior Forensic Accountants for review and approval of forensic reports.
Facilitate the handing over of evidence to designated authorities.
Ensure forensic outputs withstand judicial scrutiny including testifying in court regarding forensic report findings and prepare visual aids to substantiate findings. and support successful prosecution or asset forfeiture outcomes.
Block proceeds of criminal activity as required in terms of Section 34 of the FIC Act.
Act as final technical reviewer for Associate Forensic Accountant outputs prior to submission to Senior Forensic Accountant or Manager level.
Forensic Evidence Advocacy and Awareness
Act and contribute as a recognised subject matter expert within one or more specialised forensic domains (e.g. proceeds of crime, procurement fraud, crypto asset investigations).
Provide technical advocacy, training and/or awareness to relevant stakeholders on financial crime components.
Assist in compiling reports and case studies for training purposes and benchmarking.
Participate in the transfer of skills to team members to enhance overall effectiveness and capacity.
Advise management of financial intelligence and evidence challenges as appropriate.
Represent the FIC as a technical authority in external forums, task teams, or expert engagements.
Stakeholder Management
Coordinate and lead meetings with stakeholders to gain insights and determine requirements for forensic evidence support.
Ensure continuous stakeholder interface for seeking clarities, closing gaps, and enriching the data integrity of the forensic reports and affidavits.
Represent the organisation at working groups, meetings, conferences and seminars when required.
Utilise investigative experience and technical knowledge to work with the law enforcement agencies to investigate or prosecute serious or complex financial crimes
Risk and Compliance Management
Lead the development, review, and continuous improvement of forensic methodologies, standards, and operating procedures within the Forensic Accountancy stream.
Manage material forensic, legal, and reputational risk arising from complex investigations.
Provide input into tactical plans and targets when required.
Implement fraud controls, risk prevention principles, sound governance and compliance processes, and tools to identify and manage risks with the business unit.
Assist in monitoring changes in the regulatory environment and the implementation of appropriate operational controls to address new requirements.
Support and provide evidence to internal and external audit requirements when required.
Maintain quality risk management standards in line with the organisation's risk management framework.
Maintain and enforce all forensic related Service Level Agreements to minimise business risk and ensure business continuity.
Adhere to all relevant laws, policies, and Standard Operating Procedures throughout the organisation.
EDUCATIONAL AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS
Honours Degree in Accounting, Forensic Accounting, Internal Audit or Criminal Law
Association of Certified Fraud Examiners - ACFE - CFE-Full Membership CFE
Institute of Commercial Forensic Practitioners - ICFP - FP (SA)-Full Membership
Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists - ACAMS - CAMS Specialist Membership Certification Preferred
Association of Certified Financial Crime Specialist - ACFCS - CFCS-Individual Membership Certification Preferred
6 Years forensic investigations experience (criminal, financial crime, and proceeds of crime focused) with proven practical experience in collating, analysing, and preparing forensic financial evidence to support criminal investigations, prosecutions, and asset forfeiture processes, including work within multi agency or law enforcement environments and preparation of court ready investigative outputs.

About the position
About the Role
An established and growing national trade publication serving the construction, plumbing, artisan and broader trade markets is looking to appoint a highly driven Sales & Business Development Executive. This is a genuine new-business development role for someone who enjoys prospecting, opening doors, building relationships and converting commercial opportunities into revenue. The publication is approximately two years old and has already demonstrated strong commercial potential without previously having a dedicated salesperson or formal sales function. Advertising sales of approximately R155,000 have been achieved in a single month, despite sales historically being handled by existing team members alongside their primary responsibilities. The business is now investing in a dedicated sales function for the first time and is looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to build, structure and grow the commercial side of the publication. This is not an account-management role where the successful candidate will inherit a mature book of business. The successful candidate will be expected to proactively generate opportunities, develop a pipeline and help build a professional, structured sales process.
The Opportunity
The successful candidate will have access to:
An existing prospect and contact database.
Historical sales information.
Active and warm opportunities already in the pipeline.
An established advertising rate card.
Existing industry contacts and market intelligence.
Sales and marketing material.
Support from management, editorial and the wider team.
However, proactive prospecting, cold outreach and building a personal pipeline will remain fundamental to the role. The business believes there is significant untapped opportunity within the market and is looking for someone who sees the potential in building towards meaningful long-term revenue growth.
Key Responsibilities
New Business Development
Proactively identify and develop new advertising and commercial opportunities.
Conduct cold calling, outbound prospecting and direct outreach to prospective advertisers.
Build relationships with companies operating within construction, plumbing, manufacturing, trade, industrial and related B2B markets.
Engage with marketing managers, business owners, commercial leaders and other relevant decision-makers.
Convert prospects into new advertising clients.
Develop new relationships with industry partners and commercial stakeholders.
Identify new sectors and advertiser categories that align with the publication's audience.
Pipeline Development & Management
Build and maintain a healthy, qualified sales pipeline.
Work existing prospect and industry databases while continuing to generate new leads independently.
Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects.
Manage opportunities through the full sales process from initial contact through to close.
Maintain accurate information relating to:
Prospects.
Opportunities.
Follow-ups.
Expected revenue.
Forecast close dates.
Conversion activity.
Help establish a more structured and professional sales process within the business.
Contribute towards developing reliable data around sales cycles, conversion rates and pipeline performance.
Advertising & Commercial Sales
Present advertising opportunities and commercial packages professionally.
Clearly communicate the value and reach of the publication to prospective advertisers.
Understand client objectives and recommend suitable advertising solutions.
Prepare and present proposals and advertising options.
Negotiate professionally while protecting commercial value.
Close new advertising business.
Identify opportunities for repeat campaigns and longer-term advertising relationships.
Account Development
While new business is the primary focus, the successful candidate will also:
Maintain strong relationships with customers once business has been secured.
Encourage repeat advertising.
Identify upselling and additional commercial opportunities.
Maintain regular contact with advertisers.
Develop long-term relationships that contribute to recurring revenue.
Sales Reporting & Forecasting
Maintain disciplined records of sales activity.
Produce accurate sales forecasts.
Track conversion and pipeline progression.
Report regularly on:
New prospects.
Meetings.
Proposals.
Pipeline value.
Sales closed.
Expected revenue.
Identify market feedback, competitor activity and commercial opportunities.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for a genuine new-business salesperson, rather than someone whose experience is predominantly account management or servicing existing customers.
The ideal candidate will:
Have a strong hunter mentality.
Enjoy cold prospecting and opening new doors.
Be commercially minded and results-driven.
Have proven ability to generate their own pipeline.
Be confident engaging with business owners and senior decision-makers.
Be highly organised and disciplined with follow-up.
Demonstrate strong relationship-building capability.
Be comfortable working independently.
Take ownership of commercial outcomes.
Be motivated by uncapped earning potential.
Be excited by the opportunity to help build a sales function rather than simply inherit an established portfolio.
Experience
Relevant experience could include:
B2B sales.
Media sales.
Advertising sales.
Sponsorship sales.
Exhibition or event sales.
Business development.
Construction industry sales.
Plumbing or trade-sector sales.
Manufacturing or industrial sales.
Other commercially focused B2B environments.
Experience in media or publishing would be advantageous, but strong sales ability and proven new-business development capability are the priority.
Key Skills & Competencies
Proven new-business development ability.
Cold calling and outbound prospecting.
Lead generation.
Pipeline management.
Strong closing ability.
Commercial negotiation.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Relationship management.
Proposal presentation.
Strong administration and follow-through.
Forecasting and reporting.
Ability to work independently.
High levels of resilience and persistence.
Strong commercial judgement.
Comfortable working towards clear revenue targets.
Working Arrangement
The role operates on a four-day working week, Monday to Thursday.
Fridays are generally kept free for personal administration and appointments, providing an attractive additional benefit alongside the basic salary and uncapped commission structure.
What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will help establish a structured and sustainable sales function by:
Growing monthly advertising revenue.
Building a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.
Generating consistent new business.
Converting existing warm prospects.
Increasing repeat advertising revenue.
Developing new industry relationships.
Introducing disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.
Establishing reliable forecasting.
Tracking conversion rates and sales-cycle performance.
Helping the publication materially grow its commercial market share.
Why This Role Will Appeal
This is an opportunity to join a young and growing trade publication at a point where it is investing properly in sales for the first time. The successful candidate will have an existing foundation to work from, including market traction, active prospects, historical sales information, a rate card, industry contacts and management support. At the same time, there is significant opportunity for the right salesperson to build something meaningful, establish a professional sales function and directly influence the commercial growth of the business. It is particularly well suited to an ambitious salesperson who wants ownership, uncapped earning potential, a four-day working week and the opportunity to build rather than simply maintain an existing sales portfolio.
***Salary - R25,000 CTC + Commission (Negotiable - Based on experience, skill & in relation to your current package)

Liaise with employees and supervisors to resolve timekeeping discrepancies.
Ensure time and attendance records reconcile accurately with payroll.
HR Administration
Maintain accurate employee personnel files and HR records.
Assist with onboarding and administration of new employees.
Process employee movements, promotions, transfers, terminations and changes to employment information.
Administer leave and attendance records.
Assist with disciplinary and grievance processes.
Prepare HR reports and documentation as required.
Provide general HR administration support to management and employees.
Employee & Labour Relations
Handle employee queries and concerns professionally and confidently.
Deal calmly and fairly with difficult or confrontational situations.
Support management with employee relations matters.
Liaise with trade unions and shop stewards where required.
Assist with disciplinary hearings, grievances, consultations and other labour-related processes.
Maintain professional relationships with employees, supervisors, management and union representatives.
Escalate complex or sensitive labour matters appropriately.

Relevant qualification or experience in Payroll, Human Resources, Finance or a related field.

Set the standards, lead the people and build facilities systems that work nationally.
Is this you?
You're an assertive, highly organised facilities leader who communicates with confidence and gets to the point. Detail matters, but so does the bigger operational picture. You're proactive, commercially astute and comfortable holding regional teams and suppliers accountable. Strong systems, accurate reporting and permanent solutions are how you operate.

Location: Cape Town, Western Cape
Position Overview
My client is urgently looking for an Account Manager who will be responsible for managing, retaining and developing corporate, mining, public-sector and institutional client accounts. The role serves as the primary commercial and operational point of contact and is accountable for ensuring that client requirements are accurately understood, documented, communicated and delivered in accordance with approved service-level agreements, quotations, project scopes, compliance obligations and internal operating procedures.
Main Duties and Responsibilities
Client Account Management
Manage client relationships and act as the main point of contact.
Understand client needs, operations and service requirements.
Coordinate projects, service delivery, reporting and follow-ups.
Conduct regular client reviews and maintain accurate account records.
Manage expectations and ensure confidentiality of client information.
Client Retention & Account Growth
Retain and grow existing client accounts through proactive communication and service oversight.
Identify opportunities to expand services and develop strategic accounts.
Promote relevant services and support renewals, pricing reviews and service expansions.
Identify future client needs and ensure opportunities are properly recorded and followed through.
Hardware Requirements & Store Opportunities
Identify and document client IT hardware needs, replacement cycles and technology-refresh plans.
Assess requirements for laptops, desktops, monitors, servers, networking equipment and peripherals.
Identify opportunities for new, refurbished or pre-owned equipment.
Refer qualified opportunities to the relevant sales/technical teams and support quotations.
Maintain accurate CRM records and follow up on opportunities.
Ensure recommendations are suitable and aligned with approved pricing, availability and specifications.
Project & Service Coordination
Coordinate client service requests, project requirements, timelines and logistics.
Liaise with internal teams to ensure clear and accurate project instructions.
Coordinate site assessments, collections, audits and decommissioning projects.
Monitor projects from initiation through completion and client sign-off.
Escalate delays, risks, discrepancies and complaints promptly.
Ensure services are delivered according to approved quotes, SLAs and scope.
Quotations & Commercial Administration
Prepare and coordinate quotations, proposals, pricing and service agreements.
Ensure commercial documents accurately reflect scope, pricing and timelines.
Liaise with finance and management for pricing approvals.
Maintain records of quotes, POs, contracts and client approvals.
Assist with tenders, RFQs, supplier onboarding and approved negotiations.
Reporting & Documentation
Ensure accurate and timely project documentation and client reports.
Coordinate asset registers, chain-of-custody records, certificates and settlement reports.
Review documentation for accuracy and completeness before client submission.
Track outstanding approvals, sign-offs and supporting documentation.
Ensure all assets are accurately accounted for and support client audits.
Service-Level Agreement Management
Manage client contracts, SLAs and project requirements.
Monitor service levels, turnaround times and reporting deadlines.
Identify and resolve potential SLA issues proactively.
Track complaints, service failures and corrective actions.
Report account risks and service performance to management.
Client Complaints & Escalations
Handle and coordinate responses to client complaints and escalations.
Investigate issues, identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
Escalate serious security, compliance, safety or asset-related incidents.
Maintain accurate complaint records and client communications.
Identify recurring issues and recommend service improvements.
Financial & Account Control
Monitor account revenue, profitability, payments and outstanding invoices.
Liaise with finance on invoicing, POs, credit notes and settlements.
Assist with invoice disputes and outstanding documentation.
Support account forecasting, pipeline reporting and financial-risk management.
CRM & Record Management
Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM and account records.
Record client interactions, requirements, opportunities, quotes and actions.
Track opportunity stages, values and expected close dates.
Maintain clear records of client instructions and approvals.
Prepare account and pipeline reports for management.
Stakeholder Coordination
Build strong relationships with key client and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate effectively across operations, logistics, technical, finance and sales teams.
Ensure clear roles, responsibilities and approval processes.
Facilitate client meetings and maintain professional communication.
Compliance, Data Security & Environmental Responsibility
Ensure projects comply with company procedures, contracts and legal requirements.
Support POPIA, data-security, chain-of-custody, environmental and safety compliance.
Ensure secure handling of data-bearing devices and client assets.
Report security, safety, asset-loss and compliance incidents promptly.
Support client sustainability and responsible-disposal objectives.
Key Performance Indicators
Client retention rate and contract/SLA renewal rate.
Revenue and gross profit generated from assigned accounts.
Growth in revenue from existing clients and successful introduction of additional services.
Number and value of qualified hardware requirements identified and referred.
Conversion rate and revenue generated from referrals.
Accuracy and completeness of stakeholder hardware requirement information.
Client satisfaction, complaint-resolution performance and reduction in repeated service failures.
Percentage of reports and project documentation delivered within agreed turnaround times.
Accuracy and completeness of client documentation and serial-number reconciliation.
Number and value of active opportunities and accuracy of account forecasts.
CRM accuracy, activity-recording compliance and completion of formal account reviews.
Outstanding invoice and payment-resolution performance.
Compliance with internal procedures, client requirements and management-system standards.
Achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual account targets.
Minimum Qualifications and Requirements
Diploma or degree in Business Management, Sales, Marketing, Account Management, Information Technology, Environmental Management, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
Drivers License and own vehicle.
Computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Office, CRM systems and reporting tools.
Basic knowledge of business IT hardware, including desktops, laptops, monitors, servers, storage devices, networking equipment, peripherals and components.
Ability to identify, clarify and document stakeholder hardware requirements accurately.
Alternative Requirements
3 – 5 years experience in account management, business development, IT services, IT asset management, technology sales, recycling, logistics or environmental services.
Experience managing corporate, mining, government or institutional clients.
Experience coordinating operational service delivery across multiple departments.
A proven record of client retention, revenue growth, sales opportunity development and complaint resolution.
Practical knowledge of quotations, purchase orders, contracts, invoicing and service-level agreements.

To provide SAP technology solution expertise, advice and support in practice formulation and associated best practice improvement tactics, in order to enable tactical translation and operational implementation.

Process:
·        Perform complex tasks and guide implementation, maintenance and support of various SAP modules to enhance business functionality and overall performance, while maintaining customer satisfaction.
·        Close communication with functional teams and designers, understand the requirements from provided functional designs and transform these requirements into technical designs.
·        Analyse and review requirements, perform configuration and testing in various SAP modules, such as Finance, Contract Accounting, Revenue Management, etc.
·        Perform in-depth analysis of the current business processes and scenarios of the client, then recommend or configure solutions to meet the client’s needs.
·        Responsible for successful implementation of SAP, providing in-depth functional knowledge and advice on SAP products to clients.
·        Provide expert knowledge of industry best practices and recommend changes to optimise processes, systems, policies and procedures, and execute the implementation of change and innovation initiated by the organisation.
·        Act as liaison with the client for troubleshooting: investigate, analyse and solve critical SAP functional and application problems and map client business requirements, processes and objectives; develop necessary product modifications to satisfy clients’ needs.
·        Maintain a working knowledge of the organisation and adhere to all organisational standards.
·        Plan maintenance of current system solutions for various SAP modules, such as Finance, Contract Accounting, Revenue Management, etc.
·        Contribute to high productivity and motivation of the working team with the use of your communication skills and cooperation; reach and realise project aims and outputs.
·        Review documentation for approval of all work tasks (definition) based on BRS and ensure adherence to SAP Support SDLC.
·        Incident resolution for Severity 1 and 2 issues and assist with business escalations for issues raised.
·        Plan, design work classes and plan production release deployments.
·        Conduct assessments and use information to advise, make recommendations and facilitate improvement.
·        Ensure maintenance of current system solutions.
·        Perform moderate to complex configuration activities specifically on SAP.
Governance:
·        Develop and/or align governance and compliance policies for own practice area to identify and manage risk exposure and liability.
People:
·        Integrate new knowledge and transfer skills attained through formal and informal learning opportunities in the execution of your job.
·        Provide specialist know-how, support, advice and practice thought leadership in area of expertise.
Finance:
·        Implement and monitor financial control, management of costs and corporate governance in area of specialisation.
Client:
·        Develop and ensure implementation of a practice that builds service delivery excellence and encourage others to provide exceptional stakeholder service.
·        Participate in the specialist practice community and contribute positively to organisation knowledge management.
·        Provide authoritative, specialist expertise and advice to internal and external stakeholders.
RequirementsWhat you need:
·        Bachelor’s Degree / Advanced Diploma (NQF 7) in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, BCom, Finance, Management or Engineering, and at least 8–10 years’ experience in an SAP environment/module (FICA), of which a minimum of 3–4 years at specialist level.
Or
·        Diploma (NQF 6) and at least 10 years’ experience in an SAP environment/module (FICA), of which 3–4 years at specialist level.
Or
·        Senior Certificate (NQF 4) and 15 years’ experience in an SAP environment/module (FICA), of which a minimum of 3–4 years at specialist level.
Minimum functional requirements:
·        SAP FICA module analysis, design and configuration experience.
·        SAP FICA module functional training or relevant certification, for example SAP Finance.
·        SAP PSCD, TRM or BRF+ is an added advantage.
·        Exposure to S/4HANA implementation, Fiori applications, NWBC and SAP integration solutions (for example IDocs, OData) is an added advantage.
If FICA is your craft, you have already sat at specialist level, and you want a 12-month contract inside a financial services organisation that runs on Finance, Contract Accounting and Revenue Management, this is the brief. Apply before 16 October 2026.

To get started with your application, click the link below to apply or visit ourCareers page on the website:
https://confluent.simplify.hr/vacancy/pucjgq
If you've just finished your qualification in any financial industry related field like Management, Finance, Business, or Accounting, for example - then keep reading, you'll want to hear this.
Confluent has permanent opportunities available for young talent like you. If you come with energy, confidence, and ambition the rest will come.
What is the rest you ask? Growth, exposure, support, and a chance to help real people every day.
Summary:
We are looking for intelligent and motivated graduates to join our Onboarding team as Financial Assessors, ultimately progressing into the Financial Consultant role within 6-12 months. As a Financial Assessor, you'll contact consumers who need financial assistance and have expressed their interest in our services. First, you will gather their information and then you'll provide them with an initial/light assessment of their financial position and educate them about the ways in which we can help them with our solutions.
You will need to be a quick-thinking and decisive individual who can manage client expectations and answer their questions in a timely and informative manner. As a Financial Assessor, you'll be the first point of contact in a client's debt management journey which makes you an important ambassador for the brand, and a significant part of our solution funnel. So, you'll have to come with energy, friendliness, and professionalism.
In addition, you'll be using our systems to connect with clients and transfer them to the next stage in our process (Financial Consultants) - so being tech savvy will be beneficial.
Financial Assessors are a key part of our consumers' journey. We'll provide extensive induction and role specific training to you, to ensure that you're fully prepared for the challenge.
What makes this role even better, is that there are many opportunities to grow. Should you find yourself being a top performer, there is great potential for you to join our Financial Consulting team, where you can make an even greater impact on the lives of consumers.
Responsibilities:
Contact clients who have made enquiries with the company to gather information about their financial situation.
Assessing client financial information to determine their financial position.
Conducting financial assessments - gathering, checking and interpreting a client's full financial picture so the next stage of the journey can be completed accurately.
Make outbound calls to potential clients.
Manage consumer engagements on our various platforms and/or Outbound Channels.
Working and following up on your WIP (work in progress) - owning your pipeline rather than waiting for it to be worked for you.
Provide excellent customer service and manage client expectations accordingly.
Meeting daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Job shadowing across both the Financial Assessor and Financial Consultant sides of the journey, so you understand where your client is going next.
Transfer eligible consumers to our expert Financial Consulting team to complete a thorough assessment.
Requirements:
Matric - compulsory.
Bachelor's degree / National Diploma in a financial industry related field.
Computer Literate - MS Office
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
Willingness to work shifts.
Advantageous:
A Commerce degree.
An additional language - working proficiency in Afrikaans or another South African language.
Previous sales experience, particularly in a contact centre environment.
Experience in a customer service role.
Skills and competencies we are looking for:
Accuracy: You handle detailed information carefully and stay attentive to detail, even when the volume is high.
Adaptability: You adjust how you work with each individual rather than running the same script at everybody.
Analysing and forming opinions: You examine matters systematically and work through them in a structured way.
Client focus: You identify what a client actually needs and respond to it, rather than to what you assumed they needed.
Results oriented: You demonstrate commitment to agreements and follow through on what you said you would do.
Persuasiveness: You present your ideas and opinions with clear arguments, in order to reach an agreement.
Cooperation: You work with others to contribute to a shared objective.
Integrity: You comply with generally accepted standards in everything related to the role.
Performing under pressure: You maintain effective performance under pressure, and when faced with setbacks or disappointments.
Assertiveness: You stand up for yourself effectively and hold your position when it matters.
Benefits:
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunity to work with a talented team of professionals.
Chance to make a real difference in the lives of our clients.
Opportunity to grow and develop your career.
Debt Counselling registration - we support and fund your DC registration, which is what opens the Financial Consultant route to you.
Access to bursaries to further your studies.
Short courses to advance your career within Confluent.
Medical & Retirement Annuity Benefits and more.
Half a day off for your birthday.
Company Transportation provided when applicable.
Who is Confluent?
As an award-winning industry leader in financial advice and solutions, Confluent is positioned to operate in a largely underserved market and will continue to grow. We have big plans for our future, and that could include you!
The people who thrive here genuinely care about making a difference, are self-motivated and driven, creative thinkers and collaborators, and are hungry to learn and grow.
Are you looking to use your newly earned qualification not only in the finance sector but also to add meaning and purpose to your career? If so, Confluent is the place to be.
The work we do and the way we do it makes a real, lasting difference to the lives of those we reach.

About the position
Position Title:
Specialist ERP (Human Resources) SAP S4/HANA (3 - 6 months onsite)
Reports to:
Lead ERP (Finance & HR)
Operation/Function:
Digital Technology Department ERP
Location:
Johannesburg
REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS
Internal Reporting / Key Relationships
Platform Teams, Operations Teams, Projects, Supply, Finance, Risk, HR, Marketing, Operations, Basis, Associated Business Process Leads and Business Subject Matter Experts.
External Reporting / Key Relationships
Outsource Service Provider (OSP), Strategic Vendors, Niche Vendors, Platform capability groups, Technology Research Organisations, SAP.
PURPOSE
The role of Specialist ERP (Human Resources (HR) is one of several that act as the end-to-end Functional and Technical custodian of the SAP HR and SuccessFactors product suite. With a customer success centric mindset, the Specialist ERP (HR) will oversee and manage all execution within the SAP platform for their domain of accountability.
The responsibilities of the Specialist ERP (HR) include governance, analysis, improvement, design, monitoring, innovation, availability management and risk management relating to the SAP HR and SuccessFactors domain.
The Specialist ERP (HR) will be dedicated to managing people, processes and technology through the stabilization, maintenance, continuous improvement projects and innovation for the Human Resources domain at the organization. In this role the Specialist ERP (HR) will be responsible for ensuring that the needs of the relevant Business Operations and other Functions are supported, and value is delivered through the ERP activities, services and practices.
The Specialist ERP (HR) has technical and business operations understanding for their specific modules and maintain strong awareness of changes in the business environment in order to ensure that the delivery of ERP services is aligned to organisational requirements.
ACCOUNTABILITIES
Strategy and Planning
Contribute to the vision and strategy for the ERP Platform delivery model.
Contribute to the development of the ERP Human Resources roadmap and Technology Plans.
Assist and contribute to the ERP Platform plans including maintenance and improvement.
Identify and share the value drivers for the ERP Platform across the organisation.
Be adaptable to change of the business and Technology strategies through the ERP Platform practices and services.
Assist with identifying areas of cost and productivity improvement and contribute ideas to the planning process.
ERP Platform Management
Assist with the establishment and governance of the ERP Platform practices and processes in collaboration with suppliers and the broader Platform Teams.
Ensure effective and efficient delivery of ERP services and solutions to the Functions and Operations and take responsibility for the support of all applicable ERP activities.
Ensure engagements of business stakeholders and Service providers are clearly articulated and adhered to.
Adhere to the Technology processes and procedures specifically the customer engagement, change and communication plans and strategies.
Ensure service level requirements of the ERP Platform are clearly articulated and managed with the AMS Service providers.
Manage and monitor ERP Human Resources BAU activities including incidents, change requests and escalations.
Manage the support vendor on delivery within the module in terms of SLA, deliverable timelines and quality.
Ensure ongoing feedback loops with the customers based in the Functions and at site in the Operations in relation to stakeholder requirements, expectations and satisfaction.
Monitor the performance of the Service Management Platform and work with the suppliers to identify and close gaps/issues.
Effectively manage the relevant assets of the ERP Platform, including procedures, policies and documentation.
Maintain a strong awareness of business processes that the ERP Platform supports and seek to continuously collaborate with Business representatives to improve the processes while minimising disruption.
Be a key contact for Human Resources ERP activities and effectively manage relationships with the Function and Operation teams.
Contribute to the development and improvement of the ERP Human Resources capabilities.
Contribute to the fostering of a continuous improvement culture to ensure ongoing enhancement and optimisation of platform capabilities and technical skills.
Drive and encourage peer engagement across the Technology Platform Teams as well as the operational teams.
Manage the relationship with the Business Process Leads and Stakeholders which includes regular engagement sessions.
Act as the gatekeeper for the organization in terms of changes affecting the System and advise on policies and procedures for ERP.
Ensure that all deliverables are met for the TAG (Technical Advisory Group) process.
Continuous self-development in the relevant SAP area and domain.
LEADERSHIP (IF APPLICABLE)
Total Headcount Direct Reports:
0
Indirect Reports (incl. contractors):
3 - 12
Position Titles (Direct Reports only):
n/a
QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
Qualification/s Required
Relevant IT qualification (BTech, Degree) preferred.
SAP HR and SuccessFactors Certification required.
Working Experience
Minimum 7 - 10 years working experience in SAP HR and SuccessFactors.
Technical/Specialist Skills Required
Deep technical skills and knowledge of SAP HR and SuccessFactors practices and lifecycle.
Demonstrated understanding of the SAP ERP system and integration points within SAP ERP, and Peripheral systems e.g. Ariba, MES.
Management and Integration of the systems that are required for ERP Human Resources services.
Experience with working alongside architects, understanding SAP architecture patterns.
SAP Access and Security management for SAP Human Resources.
Experience in executing proof of concepts to assess the value of use cases.
A passion for the SAP technology and the opportunities for the change it brings.
Strength in communication. Ability to let their strength and personal character show through their communication and empower those who work with them.
Ability to be flexible and to change course, when needed, to find new ways of achieving goals.
Ability to look beyond internal data and seek insight, pulling inspiration for innovation and growth beyond the organization and the mining industry.
Ability to strike a balance between customer needs and technical capability.
A curious problem solver with the ability to identify signals and patterns, bringing in third-party problem-solving capabilities when needed.
High emotional awareness and strong interpersonal/communication skills.
Customer focused. Puts customer first and demonstrates a commitment to ensuring satisfaction.
Passionate about making a difference.
The ability to think carefully about the likely effects on others of words, actions, appearance and mode of behaviour.
Systems thinker.
Competencies
Experience in working in SAP HR and SuccessFactors platforms on a global scale.
Demonstrate experience in forming and maintaining SAP HR and SuccessFactors practices, framework and processes.
Strong experience of working alongside AMS partners.
Demonstrate SAP HR and SuccessFactors experience.
Demonstrate ability to embed a culture of continuous learning and improvement focused on value creation.

SAP ERP

About the position
South African Sugarcane Research Institute (SASRI), a division of the South African Sugar Association (SASA), is seeking to appoint a Research Farm Manager: Pongola Research Station on a permanent basis. The position will be based at SASRI's Breeding and Field Resource Unit (BFRU) in Pongola.
Pongola is SASRI's largest research station, and much of the work done there shapes the future of irrigated sugarcane in South Africa. It is home to our irrigated plant breeding programme, as well as smut, ripener and tawny rust trials and the evaluation of international varieties. Growers in Pongola, Komati and Malelane depend on the new varieties that come out of this work.
We are looking for an experienced Farm Manager who knows irrigation inside out and can give our researchers the well-run, well-watered station their trials depend on.
About the role
The Research Farm Manager runs the day-to-day operation of the station. The job is to create the best possible conditions for field experiments, run the station as a productive commercial unit, and look after the land for the long term. You will lead a team of about 61 people (39 permanent and 22 seasonal), supported by an Assistant Farm Manager, and report to the Research Stations' Manager.
Irrigation: central to this role
At Pongola, research simply doesn't work without reliable irrigation. You will be fully responsible for the station's irrigation system. That includes:
Planning and running irrigation schedules that meet the needs of each trial and the commercial crop.
Understanding how the system works, from pumps and mainlines to in-field infrastructure, so that faults are spotted early and fixed properly.
Setting up and managing a preventative maintenance programme for all irrigation infrastructure to avoid damage, water loss and downtime.
Managing water use responsibly and cost-effectively.
What else you'll be doing
Drawing up and carrying out long-term plans so that conditions suit research trials, from land preparation and planting through to cane husbandry and harvesting.
Following breeders' and researchers' instructions accurately and arranging the resources needed to establish their trials.
Allocating staff, equipment and inputs cost-effectively, in line with research priorities.
Keeping all farm assets in good repair through regular servicing and preventative maintenance.
Maintaining strict soil conservation practices in line with SUSFARMS principles and other industry standards.
Running the station as a commercial unit, recovering cane efficiently and delivering it to the mill once research needs have been met.
Preparing and managing the station budget and providing monthly variance notes.
Chairing bi-monthly meetings with Shop Stewards of the recognised trade union, reporting back at quarterly meetings, and taking part in annual wage negotiations.
Building good relationships with staff, neighbouring farms, suppliers, growers and other industry stakeholders.
Implementing and complying with all Health and Safety regulations.
What you'll need
A Diploma or BSc in Agriculture.
Proven, hands-on experience managing irrigation systems, including scheduling, maintenance and troubleshooting. A minimum of 3 seasons experience.
Experience supervising farm staff and operations, preferably including at least 18 months at management level.
Sound crop management experience.
Good mechanical knowledge.
A valid driver's licence.
It would be a plus if you have
A Senior Certificate in Sugarcane Agriculture.
Experience growing sugarcane under irrigation.
Experience in budgeting and labour relations.
Working conditions
On-site accommodation is provided for the successful candidate and their family. The role requires working farm hours (6 am to 3 pm), after-hours and weekend work when needed, and standby duty every second weekend.

Corporate governance
• Assist with the design, implementation and ongoing review of the corporate governance framework.

• Assist the Board and relevant committees with oversight of ethics and compliance programmes.
• Provide governance support to risk management and assurance processes.
• Maintain conflict-of-interest, declaration and related governance registers.
• Support the Social, Ethics and Conduct Committee in meeting its statutory and governance responsibilities.

• Bachelor's degree in Law, Corporate Governance, Commerce, Business Administration or a related discipline.
• A Chartered Governance Professional qualification through CGISA or CGI, or active progress towards the qualification, will be advantageous.
• Five to eight years of relevant company secretarial or corporate governance experience.
• Previous experience supporting Boards and Board Committees in banking, financial services or a listed organisation.
• Strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, Banks Act, Prudential Authority requirements, FSCA regulations and King IV principles.
• Demonstrated ability to draft clear, accurate Board and committee minutes and resolutions.

About the position
Our Client is looking for a
Events Coordinator to join their team.
Location: Stellenbosch
Position Overview
We are seeking a highly organized, creative, and hands-on Event Coordinator to plan, coordinate, and execute a wide range of events at our prestigious Wine Estate, including weddings, private functions, corporate events, and wine experiences.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in event planning and hospitality, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. This is a dynamic, client-facing role requiring excellent communication, logistical, and problem-solving skills, along with the flexibility to work evenings and weekends as events require.
Key Responsibilities
Event Planning & Coordination
Plan, coordinate, and execute all events hosted at the wine estate, including weddings, celebrations, private functions, and corporate gatherings.
Meet with clients to understand their vision, preferences, and event requirements.
Prepare and present event proposals, quotations, and detailed itineraries.
Coordinate with the in-house hospitality, kitchen, and vineyard teams to ensure smooth event execution.
Develop event layouts, floor plans, and schedules.
Conduct pre-event briefings and post-event evaluations.
Ensure all events reflect the estate’s standards of excellence and brand image.
Supplier & Stakeholder Management
Source and manage relationships with third-party service providers such as florists, décor specialists, photographers, musicians, and caterers.
Drive to meet with suppliers and oversee setup and logistics on-site.
Negotiate rates, confirm bookings, and ensure timely delivery of services.
Coordinate permits, contracts, and other documentation required for events.
Client Relations
Serve as the main point of contact for clients from booking to event completion.
Conduct venue viewings and site visits with prospective clients.
Provide guidance and professional recommendations on décor, layout, and event flow.
Handle client queries, special requests, and last-minute changes with professionalism and efficiency.
Operational & Administrative Tasks
Maintain accurate records of bookings, budgets, invoices, and event documentation.
Create detailed event timelines and ensure all internal departments are informed of their roles.
Support marketing efforts by contributing to event-related social media content or photography.
Uphold compliance with safety, health, and liquor licensing regulations.
Key Requirements
Experience:
Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in event coordination, preferably within a wine estate, hotel, or high-end hospitality environment.
Proven track record in managing weddings and large-scale functions.
Skills & Competencies:
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
Creative problem-solving and quick decision-making.
Financial acumen and budget management skills.
Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and event management software (advantageous).
Other Requirements:
Valid driver’s license and own reliable vehicle.
Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays as per event schedule.
Professional appearance and client-service orientation.
Personal Attributes
Detail-oriented with a passion for creating memorable experiences.
Highly organized and able to perform under pressure.
Excellent leadership and coordination skills.
Strong sense of accountability and follow-through.
Creative flair with an eye for design and presentation.
Enthusiastic, approachable, and professional demeanour.

Als erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden gewährleisten Sie eine professionelle Betreuung und ein erstklassiges Kundenerlebnis. Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau in Wort und Schrift (zwingende Voraussetzung)
Südafrikanische Staatsbürgerschaft sowie ein einwandfreies polizeiliches Führungszeugnis

Second-Level-Support und Eskalationsmanagement
Rechtliche Anliegen: Bearbeitung regulatorischer Anfragen, Vertragsfragen und richtlinienbezogener Kundenanliegen

Zahlungen und Rückerstattungen: Bearbeitung komplexer Anfragen zu Preisstreitigkeiten, Rechnungslegung, Zahlungsprüfungen und Rückerstattungen
Compliance und Premium-Service-Standards: Einhaltung deutscher Kundenservicestandards durch professionelle Kommunikation auf Deutsch (gelegentlich auch auf Englisch), Wahrung des Datenschutzes und konsequente Befolgung interner Unternehmensrichtlinien und Prozesse.

The Company
Our client is a highly respected, independent South African architectural practice known for landmark commercial developments. The company delivers major institutional and commercial projects while offering an exciting international footprint. They provide a stable, supportive environment where top talent can truly thrive and advance.
The Opportunity
In this role, you will document exciting project packages while receiving excellent ongoing professional support. You will use your technical skills to help deliver high-profile projects smoothly and efficiently. This position offers clear career growth through a structured, highly rewarding internal development path.

Produce high-quality technical working drawings for exciting, large-scale building packages.

Create and update useful project families and manage important model components.
Attend regular project and site meetings to coordinate smoothly with professional consultants.

Relevant qualification in Architecture or Architectural Technology.
Around five years of practical experience in a professional architectural design studio.
Solid, hands-on ability to build and coordinate models directly within Revit.
Experience producing detailed technical working drawing packages for building construction.
Basic working knowledge of building site administration and local council approval processes.

A positive attitude, strong team-player spirit, and a genuine eagerness to learn.

Design, develop, test and maintain data pipelines to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into a data warehouse or data lake
Implement data quality and validation checks to ensure that data is accurate, complete and consistent.
Optimize and scale data processing and storage to handle large volumes of data and high concurrency.
Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline issues and perform root cause analysis
Develop and maintain documentation for data pipelines and processes.

Building and maintaining data pipelines using lakehouse architecture (medallion)
Extracting data from multiple sources, transforming it, and loading it into the target database
Monitoring and troubleshooting ETL jobs to ensure they complete successfully and on time.
Data Modelling and Design

Optimize database schema and indexing for efficient data retrieval
Modernise legacy data environments, migrating from on-premises solutions to cloud-native platforms such as Databricks

Implement data streaming and real-time data processing technologies.

Developing dashboards and visualizations using tools like Pyramid or other data visualization tools

Analysing data to identify trends, patterns, and insights

Ensure that data access and authorization policies are in place and adhered to

Work collaboratively with Engineering Leads, Architects, Analysts, Scrum Masters and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and provide data solutions.
Communicate data pipeline issues, status, and progress to stakeholders and project teams.
Participate in cross-functional meetings and initiatives to ensure alignment with data strategies and goals

Strong analytical/problem solving skills.

descriptions.title: Data & AI Engineer (JHB Hybrid)
descriptions.description:
DataFin was established in 1999. We pride ourselves on the fact that we have established relationships with industry leaders and a vast majority of our business is repeat business.

Duties & Responsibilities

ENVIRONMENT:
A provider of tailored Financial Solutions seeks a Data & AI Engineer to build, maintain, and improve reliable pipelines and curated datasets that feed the company’s analytics, reporting, and AI workloads, and you will help run the governed in-house AI platform that sits on top of them. This is one combined role, not a Data Engineer with an AI paragraph bolted on. Data flows from SQL Server and Azure SQL sources into Fabric, through bronze, silver, and gold layers, and out to the semantic, reporting, and AI consumption layers the business depends on. Expect the work to sit at roughly two-thirds Data Engineering and one-third applied AI in the first year, shifting further towards AI as adoption grows. Both halves run inside the same established standards, which cover metadata-driven, incremental, idempotent ELT, source control, gated deployment, and human review of anything AI-generated. You will grow into full ownership of production data and AI assets end-to-end: build it, document it, support it.
DUTIES:
Data Engineering: Governed pipelines and the estate -
Develop and maintain batch and incremental ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver trusted datasets across our SQL Server / Azure SQL / Microsoft Fabric estate.
Write and optimise T-SQL transformation logic, stored procedures, views, and reconciliation queries, following our standards (CTEs over subqueries, idempotent and metadata-driven patterns).
Build and maintain Fabric pipelines, Dataflow Gen2 flows, and Lakehouse / Warehouse data assets.
Support data modelling: dimensional models, medallion (bronze / silver / gold) layer design, partitioning, and performance optimisation for analytics workloads.
Operate the estate: orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, logging, alerting, and methodical incident resolution for data jobs and platform processes.
Implement data validation, reconciliation, row-count and parity checks so reporting outputs can be trusted and prove it with evidence.
Applied AI: The governed AI platform -
Build and maintain the curated, documented datasets, retrieval indexes, and interfaces that governed AI platform and AI-assisted use cases consume.
Help run the in-house AI platform: content ingestion, indexing, configuration, access control, and routine health checks.
Develop Python automation for AI workloads, covering data preparation, embedding and indexing jobs, evaluation harnesses, and approved API integrations.
Build and evaluate AI use cases such as search, summarisation, classification, extraction, and workflow automation, measuring each against defined success criteria with human-review checkpoints built in.
Enforce data minimisation and anonymisation on every AI path: no personal information, credentials, or production data into unapproved tools, and no uncontrolled egress of data.
Record AI evaluation evidence, including what was tested, what the model produced, what a human reviewer changed, and why, so that AI-assisted output stays traceable and auditable.
Shared: Governance, delivery, and documentation -
Work the governed delivery flow: Git / Azure DevOps source control, feature branches, peer-reviewed pull requests, and gated environment promotion (Dev → UAT → production).
Produce and maintain documentation: pipeline design notes, source-to-target mappings, runbooks, AI use-case and configuration notes, and support procedures.
Collaborate with Analysts, the Head of Data & AI, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into governed, supportable data assets, without business logic drifting into unmanaged reports.
What you’ll work with –
Azure SQL and on-premises SQL Server, which form the core transactional and reporting estate.
The wider Fabric surface, including mirroring and CDC ingestion, deployment pipelines, and capacity management.
Python for transformation, automation, and tooling; DAX exposure on the BI side.
Azure DevOps for repos, boards, CI/CD pipelines, and gated deployments.
Power BI and SSRS as the consumption layer you feed.
The governed in-house AI platform, which covers agent tooling, retrieval and indexing, and the controls that make it safe to use on sensitive data. You will help run it, not just use it.
AI-assisted engineering under policy, meaning sanitised inputs, human review of generated code, and traceable output. It is how the whole team works, and how you will work too.
Evaluation and human-review workflows, which are how we decide whether an AI output is good enough to use and how that decision is evidenced.
REQUIREMENTS:
Minimum 1-year hands-on experience in Data Engineering, ETL / ELT, analytics engineering, database development, applied AI, or a closely related production-oriented role.
Solid SQL Server and T-SQL. You should be confident with joins, aggregations, CTEs, and multi-step transformation logic, and able to debug and reason about query performance.
Demonstrable Microsoft Fabric experience. You have built, supported, or substantially prototyped at least one of the following: a Fabric pipeline, a Lakehouse or Warehouse solution, a Dataflow Gen2 flow, or a Fabric notebook. Work, internship, or serious project evidence all count.
Understanding of data warehousing and pipeline design concepts (staging, incremental loads, dimensional modelling).
Working Python. You can read, write, and modify scripts for data preparation, automation, and integration, because the AI half of the role runs on it.
Practical, sceptical familiarity with modern AI tooling. You have used LLM or AI-assisted tools on real work and can explain where they got things wrong, not just that they were useful. No formal Machine-Learning or Data-Science background is required.
Familiarity with source control (Git or similar) and structured, reviewed ways of releasing changes.
Genuine care for data quality, security, least privilege, and confidentiality, including the discipline never to put sensitive data into an unapproved tool.
Advantageous –
Python or PySpark depth for data transformation at scale.
Dataflow Gen2, mirroring / CDC, and Fabric deployment pipelines.
Power BI semantic model and DirectLake awareness; SSRS report development.
Experience with APIs, file feeds, or enterprise source systems.
Retrieval-augmented generation, vector or semantic search, and embedding concepts.
Azure AI services, prompt and evaluation frameworks, agent tooling, or MLOps exposure.
DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate) or another relevant Microsoft certification. These are valued rather than required and are achievable after appointment.
Relevant qualification (Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related) or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in a regulated financial-services or similarly controlled environment.
ATTRIBUTES:
You want to learn, so you ask good questions, absorb feedback, and close the loop.
You verify before you trust, and that includes AI output above all.
You take ownership end-to-end: build it, document it, support it.
You have a quality mindset, so you check your work and raise issues early rather than hoping.
You are comfortable with sensitive data and disciplined governance; process is a feature to you, not friction.
You keep composure in a delivery-focused environment and communicate honestly about progress and blockers.
Integrity and values, with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.
Attention to detail and a results-driven quality mindset.
Strong problem-solving; composure in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.
Works well in a team and independently; communicates openly.
Growth mindset, actively wanting to learn and develop

descriptions.description:
Introduction

About cloudandthings.io
At cloudandthings.io, we are an engineering-led consultancy focused on building modern Data and AI Platforms for enterprise clients.
We don’t just design architectures, we build real systems that power analytics, decision-making, and AI at scale. Our team acts as a force multiplier, accelerating delivery, improving quality, and unlocking measurable business value. We operate with high standards, strong ownership, and a bias for execution.
If you care about solving meaningful problems and building production-grade systems, you’ll fit right in.
We’re looking for Data Engineers across all levels (Junior to Principal) to join our growing Data, Analytics and AI capability.

Duties & Responsibilities

Overview
As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate modern, cloud-native data platforms across AWS and Azure, leveraging Databricks and Microsoft Fabric. You will work across the full data lifecycle: ingestion, transformation, modelling, and serving, enabling real-time analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
Key Responsibilities
While the list below is long, an ideal candidate should have working knowledge and experience covering many of the tools and services. The requirements for each project differ over time, and these skills provide an overview of what may typically be required of a Data Engineer.
Key Responsibilities
Software Engineering Foundations
Strong grounding in software engineering fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, design patterns).
Proficiency in Python and SQL (additional languages advantageous).
Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development practices.
Familiarity with Terraform or Bicep for Infrastructure as Code.
Comfortable working in Linux-based environments.
Data Platform Engineering (Multi-Cloud)
Data Ingestion and Streaming
Build scalable ingestion pipelines across hybrid and cloud environments.
Real-time streaming: AWS Kinesis / MSK (Kafka), Azure Event Hubs / Kafka
Batch ingestion: AWS DataSync, DMS, Azure Data Factory / Synapse Pipelines / Fabric Pipelines
Integration via APIs, JDBC/ODBC, and CDC pipelines.
Storage, Lakehouse and Fabric
Design and manage data lakes using: Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS)
Implement lakehouse architectures using: Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse)
Work with modern data formats: Parquet, Avro, JSON
Experience with: Relational databases (Postgres, SQL Server, Aurora), NoSQL (DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), Caching (Redis)
Data Processing and Transformation
Build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using: Databricks (PySpark, Delta Live Tables, Workflows), AWS Glue / Lambda, Azure Databricks / Synapse Spark / Fabric Data Engineering
Implement medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold).
Develop reusable, testable, and production-grade data pipelines.
Analytics and AI Enablement
Design platforms that support: Business Intelligence and advanced analytics, Machine learning and AI use cases
Work with: Amazon Redshift / Athena, Microsoft Fabric (Semantic Models, Direct Lake), Power BI, Databricks SQL & ML capabilities
Support: Feature engineering, Data science workflows, Real-time decisioning systems
Implement data quality, observability, and lineage frameworks.
Security, Governance & Compliance
Implement secure, enterprise-grade data platforms: AWS IAM / Azure Entra ID (AAD), RBAC, Managed Identities
Governance: Databricks Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview, AWS Lake Formation
Networking: VPC / VNets, Private Endpoints, Direct Connect / ExpressRoute
Encryption: KMS / Key Vault / TLS
Orchestration and Operations
Build orchestrated pipelines using: Databricks Workflows, AWS Step Functions / MWAA (Airflow), ADF / Synapse / Fabric Pipelines

Proven track record of designing and implementing data solutions.
Knowledge of and experience with Azure Cloud infrastructure and services.
Certifications, such as: AWS Certification, Microsoft Certification, Databricks Certification

Experience with Docker/Containers/Kubernetes/CICD pipelines for data.
Knowledge of data security and compliance standards.
Willingness to learn and expand knowledge related to Cloud and Data Technologies.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Self-organising with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with clients and team members.
Willingness to travel to clients as and when required.

Package & Remuneration

What We Offer
A culture of engineering and an environment where ideas are heard, and builders can build.
Competitive compensation and bonus structure.
A flexible and supportive work environment that values diversity, work-life balance, and personal growth.
Opportunities for career advancement and ongoing professional development.
Ongoing learning and development opportunities to enhance your skills.
Engaging with cutting-edge technologies and awesome client projects.
Access to a talented team of professionals and mentors.

An industry leading Bank has an exciting opportunity available for a
Data Engineer
to join the team that builds and maintains the data foundation powering their client engagement and campaign activity.

This team designs data assets and pipelines that deliver trusted, accurate data to Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Data360, giving CRM Architects, Specialist Client Engagement teams and Product Owners what they need to run targeted, data-driven campaigns and client journeys.
The work covers the full data lifecycle — from approved Business Requirements Specifications (BRS) through architecture, development, testing and deployment of production-ready pipelines. This team partners with Business Analysts, Product Owners and Marketing Managers to translate business decisions into deployable pipelines — and support post-campaign measurement by publishing engagement data to the EDW and Kafka Topics for continuous improvement. Deep knowledge of multiple programming languages — including advanced algorithms for
data processing
Enterprise-wide real-time and batch data integration architecture design
AWS — deep knowledge of AWS data services and architecture (our team's primary cloud platform)

Ability to performance-optimise across heterogeneous systems

Design and configuration of enterprise workflow orchestration tools and pipelines

Assist with the implementation of MDM across the organisation.
Identify and investigate inconsistencies, missing data, duplication and other data-quality issues.

Monitor data pipelines and integration processes to identify failures or performance issues.
Troubleshoot and resolve data-processing and integration errors.
Ensure that data used for reporting and analysis is accurate, complete, consistent and available when required.
Support the development of a trusted organisational data environment.
Analytics & Business Intelligence Enablement
Develop and maintain analysis-ready datasets for Data Analysts, Analyst Developers and other authorised business users.
Support the development of reliable data models for dashboards, management reporting and business intelligence solutions.
Assist analysts with complex data extraction, transformation and integration requirements.
Ensure that commonly used business information is sourced from controlled and consistent datasets.
Enable greater self-service, democratized analytics through well-structured and governed data.
The Data Engineer's primary responsibility is to build and maintain the data foundation rather than own business reporting or interpretation of business performance.
Automation & Continuous Improvement
Review existing data flows and recommend improvements.
Optimise database queries, pipelines and processing routines to improve performance.
Proactively identify opportunities where improved data integration can simplify business processes.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within Business Transformation.
Migrate data warehouse, data lake or similar data structures where applicable.

Assess data requirements when new systems, processes or technologies are introduced.
Support data migration, cleansing, mapping and validation during system implementations.
Work with Business Process Management to understand how information moves through business processes and identify opportunities for improved automation.
Provide technical data expertise during solution design and project implementation.
Support testing and implementation of new data solutions.
Assist with post-implementation troubleshooting and optimisation.
Data Governance, Security & Compliance
Apply organisational data governance standards across data engineering solutions.
Ensure appropriate access controls are implemented for sensitive and confidential information.
Work with IT and relevant stakeholders to ensure data solutions comply with information-security requirements such as POPIA and ISO27001.
Maintain appropriate controls around the extraction, transfer, storage and use of organisational data.
Support the establishment and maintenance of data stewardship, definitions and governance practices.
Documentation & Technical Support
Maintain accurate technical documentation for data pipelines, integrations and data structures.
Develop and maintain data-flow diagrams, integration specifications and data dictionaries where appropriate.
Maintain appropriate change records for data solutions.
Provide technical support and troubleshooting for data-related issues.
Ensure that critical data processes are sufficiently documented to reduce dependency on individual knowledge.
Artificial Intelligence & Agentic Capability
The Data Engineer is expected to be a user, implementer and support resource for the organisation's artificial-intelligence and agent-assisted capabilities, applying them to data engineering, data quality and business-process outcomes within approved governance and security controls.
Use AI-assisted and agentic development tooling in day-to-day engineering work — pipeline and integration development, code generation and review, test creation, documentation and troubleshooting — and validate all generated code, SQL and configuration before it reaches a governed environment.
Apply AI and machine-assisted techniques to business-process analysis, ETL/ELT development and data-quality optimisation, including anomaly detection, record matching and de-duplication, classification and rule suggestion, with human review before production use.
Build and maintain the semantic and metadata foundations that make organisational data usable by AI and agent-based tools — business glossaries, data dictionaries, ontologies and taxonomies, and governed data-product contracts — so that natural-language questions return consistent, explainable and permission-aware answers.
Support the implementation of AI-enabled platform capabilities together with Data & Systems Architecture and external technology partners, including configuration, integration, testing, user enablement and post-implementation optimisation.
Apply AI within the organisation's data-protection and information-security requirements: confidential, personal or business-sensitive data may only be processed by approved AI services, consistent with the governance requirements in 2.6.
Understanding of code harnesses and agentic coding tools, large language model behaviour, prompt engineering and retrieval-based approaches will be favourable.

CORE COMPETENCIES:
Analytical Thinking

Problem Solving

Attention to Detail

Collaboration

Ownership

Continuous Learning

descriptions.description:
Introduction

The Data Analyst – Data Migration & Data Quality will be responsible for the analysis, cleansing, manipulation, transformation, standardisation and validation of data received from DMPR regional offices to ensure that data is complete, accurate, consistent and conforms to the approved data structures, templates and business rules required for migration into the new Mining Licence/Cadastre System.
The position will work closely with the Project Team, Regional Data Capturers, GIS Specialists, Database Administrators and DMPR business representatives to ensure that regional data is converted into validated, migration-ready datasets.
The role is critical to ensuring that poor-quality, incomplete, or incorrectly formatted legacy data does not compromise the migration, implementation, and operation of the new system.

Duties & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:
Data Assessment and Profiling:
Receive and assess data submitted by the different DMPR regions.
Profile datasets to identify Missing or incomplete information, Duplicate records ,Incorrect or inconsistent values, Invalid data types, Incorrect dates and formats, Inconsistent naming conventions, Incorrect or incomplete identifiers, and missing relationships between records.
Analyse the quality and completeness of each regional dataset.
Produce data quality reports identifying issues requiring remediation.
Maintain a record of data received, data processed, and data outstanding per region.
Data Validation & Pre-migration Preparation:
Perform pre-migration validation of all datasets.
Clean and manipulate source data to conform to the approved migration requirements.
Validate data against approved business and technical rules.
Conduct completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, and validity checks.
Validate mandatory fields and accepted values.
Perform cross-field and cross-record validation where required.
Identify records that fail validation and return them for correction where necessary.
Support post-migration validation and reconciliation of migrated records.
Remove duplicate records in accordance with approved business rules.
Standardise names, codes, statuses, dates, identifiers and other relevant fields.
Identify and resolve incomplete or incorrectly captured information.
Perform data transformations required to align legacy data with the new system's data model.
Apply approved business rules to determine how legacy values should be represented in the new system.
Maintain an audit trail of significant data manipulation and transformation activities.
Migration Template Management:
Ensure that all regional data is captured in the approved migration templates.
Ensure that mandatory fields are populated before datasets are submitted for migration.
Ensure that field names, formats, data types, codes, and values comply with the approved migration specifications.
Identify fields requiring transformation before migration.
Maintain and update data mapping documentation.
Ensure that revised templates and migration specifications are consistently applied across all regions.
Data Quality Reporting:
Develop and maintain regular data-quality reports showing:
Number of records received, processed, and records successfully validated.
Number of records rejected & Number of records requiring correction.
Number of outstanding records.
Number and type of data-quality errors.
Migration readiness by region.

Desired Experience & Qualification

Qualifications & Experience:
Bachelor’s Degree/National Diploma in IT, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Informatics or related field.
3–5 years’ experience in data analysis, data cleansing, manipulation and migration.
Strong Advanced Excel and SQL skills.
Experience in data validation, standardisation, transformation and reconciliation.
Experience preparing large datasets for system implementation/migration.

The candidate should demonstrate practical ability in:
Advanced Excel, SQL.
Data profiling & Data cleansing.
Data transformation , validation & reconciliation.

Database concepts & Data modelling concepts.

Problem-solving ability.
Ability to work under tight project deadlines.
Ability to work with large volumes of data.
Strong communication skills.
Ability to work with technical and business teams.
Ability to work effectively in a high-pressure project environment.

per month
