descriptions.title: Master Data Analyst
descriptions.description:
CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 347 million pallets, crates and containers. We employ approximately 13,000 people and operate in 60 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world’s biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact.
What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model.
Job Description
The Master Data Analyst (MD Analyst) position delivers support to internal and external customers for the efficient creation and maintenance of CHEPs Customer Master Data across the AMETA region. The role of the Master Data Analyst is to manage and ensure the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of an organization's master data. The Master Data Analyst plays a critical role in data governance and data management initiatives, ensuring that master data is accurately maintained and consistently applied though auditing of Customer and Pricing Master.
The role also supports process improvement and standardisation projects to support operational efficiency across the region. This includes supporting pricing and customer projects to create account structure and pricing solutions, automations, and other improvements to support the AMETA business.
Key Responsibilities May Include
Perform detailed data analysis and quality control to identify irregularities and ensure resolution by collaborating with data engineering, business units, and IT teams.
Develop and monitor KPIs to ensure compliance with data quality SLAs and proactively address potential data issues.
Design and implement data integrity measures, including automation solutions, to streamline workflows and reduce manual errors.
Maintain and enhance master data records using systems like SAP, Salesforce, PowerBI, and SQL, ensuring that data is up-to-date, reliable, and accessible.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify process inefficiencies and recommend solutions to optimize data management and reporting capabilities aligning data quality with dynamic business needs.
Create and maintain documentation for all data-related processes, including system configurations, data governance policies, and troubleshooting procedures.
Provide training and support to internal stakeholders on data tools and processes to promote best practices and drive consistency across regions.
Participate in data-related projects, ensuring that data integrity standards are maintained throughout the implementation of new systems or process changes.
Major/Key Accountabilities
Ensuring Salesforce requests/activities are accurately and timeously completed. Requests include but are not limited to; account location opening, pricing, account closure and general support of the CHEP invoice production process
Managing the loading of new scheduled BI reporting as well as maintaining current scheduled where changes are required.
Pre and Post billing checks to be done on a weekly basis.
Responsible for the maintaining of customer master data in Salesforce and SAP where dual maintenance is required. Deliver a first-class customer service and strive to achieve departmental SLA’s.
Responding to requests via Salesforce, liaising with internal customers via email and telephone
Liaise and build relationships with other internal departments to ensure that the highest quality of master data is maintained.
Managing the integrity of master data taking appropriate action where anomalies or errors are found in the data. Manage possible blockages to ensure efficiency in all operations.
Subject Matter expert for projects impacting Masterdata.
Manage regression testing when deemed necessary.
Support Robotics process automation (RPA) through the review and testing of Master data automations and the manual processing of MD requests during Automation outages as needed.
Support annual standard pricing uprate programs through mass update of SAP pricing data.
Support change and continuous improvement projects to both organisation and process, to meet the needs of the customer and business.
Support Internal and External Audit teams reporting as requested.
Resolution of invoicing problems on a weekly basis.
Continuously reviewing processes to implement automation and process efficiencies.
Measures
Timeliness & Accuracy of Master Data updates.
SOP Compliance and Control Reporting.
Proven efficiency gains.
Customer satisfaction.
Team Engagement.
Scope
Region: AMETA
Challenges
Meeting changing business needs
Working across different countries and time zone and cultures
Meeting requirements for a broad range of internal customers across functions and disciplines
Dealing with Mass Updates/requests
Multi-tasking with day-to-day responsibilities
Dealing with project work and day to day duties
Meeting the work queue deadlines as per the SLA
Ensuring all work queues are kept up to date daily.
Qualifications
Certification in any of this : Information Systems/Computer Science/Data Analytics
Experience
Experience of data management with accuracy and attention to detail
Experience of SAP, Salesforce and Excel
Skills And Knowledge
Intermediate Microsoft Excel
Working knowledge and exposure to SAP and Salesforce systems would be advantageous
Good written and verbal communication skills
Good analytical and problem-solving skills
Must be logical and have a methodical work ethic
Minimum of 12 months experience working in a Master Data or administrative environment
Remote Type
Hybrid Remote
Skills To Succeed In The Role
Adaptability, Data Analytics, Data Governance, Data Integrity, Data Quality Assessments, Empathy, Experimentation, Master Data Management (MDM), Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (PBI), Privacy Compliance, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Tableau (Software), Taking Ownership, Teamwork, Understand Customers

descriptions.title: Senior Private Equity Fund Data Analyst
descriptions.description:
Allocator:
Allocator is a data technology company that provides an intelligence platform for institutional investors (LPs) in private markets. We help pension funds, endowments, foundations, family offices, and fund-of-funds transform how they manage and analyse their alternative investment portfolios across Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Real Estate, and Private Debt.
Using AI and other data automation systems, we collect, extract, digitise, standardise, and harmonise investment data from fund managers (GPs) across all formats and sources, including fund portals, email, and direct uploads. Our clients access unified portfolio views through our software platform, APIs, and Excel add-ins.
We are an AI-forward business. AI assistants, automations, and modern data tooling are everyday parts of how we work, and we look for people who use them fluently as core tools rather than novelties.
At Allocator, our people and culture are at the heart of our success. We strive for excellence through innovation in a collaborative and agile environment and are always looking for great people to join us in building the next generation of data management and analytics solutions for the alternative investment industry.
About the Role:
As a Senior Private Equity Fund Data Analyst at Allocator, you take ownership of our private markets data across global markets. The data team is the backbone of our business and works hand-in-hand with Customer Success, Product, and Technology to deliver the highest-quality data to our clients. We are an AI-forward team. Every analyst uses AI assistants and internal automations as part of their daily workflow to scale data quality, accelerate turnaround, and remove manual tasks.
This role is dedicated to supporting our growing US client base, and works on a US-aligned shift pattern of 14:00 to 22:00 Cape Town time. You will alternate this shift on a rotating cadence (3 days / 2 days, swapping the following week). During your shift you will join our Client Queries squad alongside owning your data work, monitoring the support inbox, triaging incoming tickets, responding to clients, and resolving issues within your area of expertise.
You will lead the final data sign-off stage for new funds, mentor junior analysts, and apply AI-assisted workflows to scale data quality without compromising accuracy.
Primary Job Responsibilities:
Work a US-aligned shift of 14:00 to 22:00 Cape Town time on a rotating cadence (3 days / 2 days, swapping each week) to support our US client base
Join the Client Queries squad during your shift, monitoring the support inbox, triaging incoming tickets, responding to clients, and resolving queries within your area of expertise
Determine, monitor, and report on the quality of client private markets data
Ensure data is delivered in a consistent format and aligned with onboarding arrangements
Own the final data sign-off stage for new funds before they go live to clients
Use AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) and internal automations as core daily tools, applying them to capital activity processing, fund document extraction, validation, drafting, and accelerating Excel-heavy work
Mentor and train junior analysts, including reviewing their outputs, supporting career development, and coaching them on effective use of AI tooling
Coordinate with Customer Success on shared issues between client delivery and data operations
Liaise with internal Data, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure client deadlines and needs are met
Identify opportunities to expand AI-augmented workflows across extraction, classification, and validation, and partner with Engineering to implement them
Contribute to broader initiatives across the company and partner with international colleagues on next-generation data systems for private markets
Skills and Qualifications:
Willingness and availability to work a 14:00 to 22:00 Cape Town shift on a rotating cadence (3 days / 2 days alternating every other week)
3 to 5 years of hands-on experience working with private markets data, ideally including time as a Private Equity Fund Accountant or in a Fund Operations role at a fund administrator or GP
Working knowledge of capital calls, distributions, NAV statements, and LP reporting cycles
Daily working fluency with AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot), with comfort using them to parse fund documents, draft validation logic, accelerate Excel work, and handle non-standard queries
Confident client-facing communicator; can engage directly with US institutional clients in writing and on calls during shift hours
Excellent written and verbal communication, with strong interpersonal skills
Strong analytical skills and high attention to detail, with advanced Excel proficiency
Ability to work collaboratively in a team and independently when needed
Structured, organised, and meticulous, with the ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
Undergraduate degree (BCom or equivalent) specialising in Investment Management, Accounting, Business Management, or Finance
Desirable:
Professional qualification (CA, CFA, CAIA, or equivalent in fund accounting or investment management)
Prior experience mentoring or leading junior analysts
Prior client-facing or support-desk experience working with US institutional clients
Experience designing or improving AI-augmented data workflows, including prompt design or automation builds (Python, SQL)
Familiarity with venture capital, real estate, or private debt fund reporting
Other Benefits:
Professional development budget (e.g. CFA, CAIA)
Private medical cover
Pension plan contributions
Flexible working with regular team socials and events
Allocator is committed to continuing to make diversity, equity, and inclusion part of everything we do, from how we build our products to how we build our workforce.

descriptions.description:
Job Title: Senior Analyst - Government
Region: South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho, eSwatini
Employing Legal Entity: Gilbarco AFS
Organization: Convenience Retail
Location: Johannesburg, South Africa
Workplace Type: (Hybrid/In-Person)
Department: Sales
Reports To: Senior Manager, Risk & Analytics
Direct Reports: None
Job Overview
To execute the daily data collection, compilation and analysis that powers the contracted analytics services at the core of Vontier's end-to-end mining solutions. The role is the operational backbone of the analytics service delivery: ensuring the data underpinning customer-facing insight is accurate, validated, reconciled on time, and free of unmanaged exceptions.
Government fleet contracts are high-value, high-scrutiny and reliant on the integrity of the analytics and financial reconciliations delivered. This role is the operational and analytical backbone of that service: combining disciplined daily execution, rigorous validation and three-way financial matching with trend analysis and exception management that protect both the customer and Vontier from financial and compliance risk.
Responsibilities
Data collection and compilation
Execute daily collection and compilation of operational data feeding the contracted analytics services.
Ensure data completeness, accuracy and consistency across all sources.
Manage data intake from multiple systems, sites and customer feeds.
Validation and reconciliation
Validate data integrity, applying quality checks and controls before analysis and reporting.
Complete reconciliations accurately and on time, in line with contractual and service commitments.
Identify, investigate and manage exceptions, anomalies and discrepancies to resolution.
Escalate unresolved or material issues to the Senior Manager promptly.
Analysis and reporting
Analyse data to identify trends, patterns and outliers relevant to customer operations and contract performance.
Produce accurate, timely analytics outputs and reports for customers and internal stakeholders.
Translate data findings into clear, meaningful insight supporting customer decision-making.
Support continuous improvement of analytics methods, controls and reporting.
Service delivery support
Ensure analytics service delivery meets SLA, accuracy and timeliness requirements.
Maintain documentation of data processes, controls and reconciliations for audit and compliance.
Essential
Required Skills / Qualifications / Certifications / Tech Stack
4+ years in a data analyst, operations analyst or reporting analyst role, ideally in mining, industrial, telematics or data-services contexts.
Strong data-handling, validation and reconciliation skills with high attention to accuracy.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (advanced Excel essential; SQL, Power BI or similar advantageous).
Ability to identify, investigate and resolve data exceptions and anomalies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into insight.
Disciplined, deadline-driven approach to recurring reconciliations and reporting.
Clear communication skills for reporting findings to internal and customer stakeholders.
Relevant tertiary qualification in data science, statistics, engineering, finance or a related quantitative field.
Preferable
Understanding of fuel transactions, fleet cards (EMV) or payment reconciliation advantageous.
Outcomes and Deliverables
Deliverables
Daily and periodic data collection, compilation and validation completed to schedule.
On-time, accurate reconciliations with documented exception management.
Regular analytics outputs, trend reports and insight summaries for customers and internal stakeholders.
Exception and anomaly registers with resolution tracking.
Maintained data-process and control documentation for audit readiness.
Escalation reports on material issues to the Senior Manager.
Outcomes
Accurate, validated data consistently underpinning the contracted analytics services.
Reconciliations completed on time, every cycle, with no material errors.
Exceptions identified, managed and resolved promptly, with clear escalation of material issues.
Meaningful trends identified, managed and reported to support customer decisions.
Analytics service delivery meeting SLA, accuracy and timeliness commitments.
High customer confidence in the integrity of the analytics underpinning their solutions.
Who Is Gilbarco Veeder-root
Gilbarco Veeder-Root, a Vontier company, is the worldwide technology leader for retail and commercial fueling operations, offering the broadest range of integrated solutions from the forecourt to the convenience store and head office. For over 150 years, Gilbarco has earned the trust of its customers by providing long-term partnership, uncompromising support, and proven reliability. Major product lines include fuel dispensers, tank gauges and fleet management systems.
Who Is Vontier
Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company powering the way the world moves. We empower businesses in the transport sector to adapt to a fast-changing landscape by uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies.
Our smart, connected solutions serve roadside convenience retail stores, fleet operators, and auto repair technicians. From integrated payments and EV charging software to carwash technology and retail automation, we help customers stay productive and prepared for a rapidly evolving industry.
With decades of expertise and a balanced portfolio, Vontier enables businesses to navigate complexity, unlock growth, and build a cleaner, safer future. Driven by continuous improvement and the dedication of Team Vontier, we empower businesses to think bigger, act boldly, and thrive on the road ahead. Learn more at www.vontier.com
At Vontier, we empower you to steer your career in the direction of success with a dynamic, innovative, and inclusive environment.
Our commitment to personal growth, work-life balance, and collaboration fuels a culture where your contributions drive meaningful change. We provide the roadmap for continuous learning, allowing creativity to flourish and ideas to accelerate into impactful solutions that contribute to a sustainable future.
Join our community of passionate people working together to navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. At Vontier, you are not on this journey alone, we are committed to equipping you with the tools and support you need to fuel your innovation, lead with impact, and thrive both personally and professionally.
Together, let’s power the way the world moves!

Duration: Permanent

BACKGROUND
Founded in 1997 by President Nelson Mandela, HRH Prince Bernhard of the Netherlands and Dr Anton Rupert, Peace Parks Foundation is a non-profit organisation pioneering conservation at scale across southern Africa.
Working through Transfrontier Conservation Areas that span national borders, Peace Parks connects protected areas, supports biodiversity conservation and ecological resilience, strengthens local economies and promotes regional peace and stability. Its holistic approach is built on three pillars: conservation at scale, community development and conservation finance, ensuring that protected areas deliver long-term ecological and economic value.
To date, Peace Parks has supported governments in establishing 780 000 km² of Transfrontier Conservation Areas across southern Africa. It also co-manages eight parks where wildlife populations have rebounded fivefold and supports more than 280 000 people annually through its interventions. With formal government mandates and strong community partnerships, Peace Parks offers a proven model for building resilience for people and nature across southern Africa’s most significant landscapes.
The Foundation’s Vision 2050 is to secure 17 fully functional transboundary landscapes spanning
980 000 km², making it one of the world’s largest land-based conservation initiatives.
www.peaceparks.org

descriptions.title: Business Analyst (Private Markets)
descriptions.description:
Sonata One is a rapidly scaling, regulated fund services and technology (fintech) business. We're The Private Funds Clearinghouse, connecting more than 53,000 investors with 6,500 funds and 180 fund managers around the globe. Our vision is to change the paradigm of private markets investing through harmonising the end-to-end investment process within one platform. Investors benefit from a seamless, one & done experience across the fund lifecycle (from fund selection and subscription through to settlement and reporting) underpinned by a globally compliant KYC passport and 24/5 support. Fund managers can raise capital faster at a lower cost from a wider pool of pre-approved investors. Founded in 2015, Sonata One has a presence in eight locations worldwide including the US, UK and Luxembourg, Guernsey, South Africa and Mauritius.
We operate as #OneGlobalThread in line with our values: We challenge the norm, we change the way we think and work, by connecting systems and people, while committing to our vision and each other. We are now looking to recruit a Business Analyst to join our global team.
Position Overview:
We are hiring a Business Analyst to play a key role in the implementation and ongoing management of Sonata One's solutions for our clients.
This is an internally focused role within our Implementation team, responsible for how Sonata One itself operates. The BA is responsible for design, documentation and improving our internal processes, so that every service line runs in a consistent, controlled and scalable way. This includes working alongside our learning and development team ensuring our people are trained to deliver those processes well.
This is a varied role sitting at the intersection of implementation, operations, CRM and technology. You will work directly with our internal stakeholders, namely the technology and operations function to understand their requirements, processes and objectives, translating these into clear business requirements and actionable plans.
This is a critical role to the scaling and success of Sonata One. We are transforming into a larger business which requires structure at all levels. You will be a trusted internal advisor, helping senior members of the team understand how Sonata One works, identifying and opportunities to improve processes and ensuring that implementations are delivered effectively.
The role will suit someone who is structured, logical, enjoys working with people, asking questions, understanding how businesses operate and turning complex requirements into clear, structured solutions.
Responsibilities
Process Mapping
Map current-state processes across service lines: Subscription, KYC/AML, Tax, Transfer Agency and investor portal
Understand and identify the gaps that exist in our existing processes, specifically between teams and the interplay between functions
Design target state processes that are standardised, efficient and scalable. We operate as one global team and do not necessarily need different procedures for different jurisdictions
Revamp and maintain our central process library: process maps, standard operating procedures, guides, and policies, including any newly developed documentation.
Working with the implementation manager to define an effective client lifecycle. Map workflow from business development to Implementation and ongoing BAU
Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and act as a key point of contact throughout implementation projects
Gather, document and analyse business and functional requirements
Translate internal requirements into clear actions, processes and deliverables for internal teams, specifically technology and operation
Identify dependencies, risks, issues and potential blockers and work collaboratively to resolve them
Gap analysis and continuous improvement
Find gaps, bottlenecks, manual workarounds and control weaknesses in how we operate today.
Prioritise improvements by impact, risk and effort, and build the business case where investment is needed.
Track improvement initiatives through to delivery and measure the benefits.
Turn feedback from client implementations, passed on by the external BA, into internal fixes.
Internal training and enablement
Work with the learning and development lead to design and deliver training for Sonata One staff on processes, systems and controls.
Build onboarding pathways for new joiners in each team
Check understanding and adherence through refreshers and spot checks, in partnership with team leads
Technology and data
Work with the externally facing BA to define requirements for system enhancements, and automation
Work with technology and product teams on testing and roll-out of internal changes
Support management information (MI) and KPI reporting on process performance.
Business Analysis
Facilitate workshops, meetings and discovery sessions with internal stakeholders
Work with the CTO, Head of Product, Director Of Operations and MD of Growth to establish business priorities for any system changes required to deliver
Map and document current-state and future-state processes
Translate business requirements into clear and actionable documentation
Ensure requirements are understood consistently across clients, Implementation, Operations, CRM and Technology
Experience Required:
Experience working as a Business Analyst in an operational, process improvement or business transformation environment
Proven experience mapping, redesigning and documenting internal processes, ideally across multiple teams or service lines
Strong understanding of change delivery and the ability to manage multiple improvement initiatives and priorities at once
Experience working with internal stakeholders, including operations, compliance and technology teams
Ability to understand complex operational processes and turn them into clear process maps, and training materials
Comfortable working with team leads and senior stakeholders, and bringing people along through process change
Ability to balance the needs of individual teams with consistency, control and scalability across the wider business
Strong understanding of:
Business analysis methodologies and techniques, including translating complex requirements into practical steps
Client implementation and onboarding
Process mapping and process improvement
Stakeholder management and client communication
Technology-enabled business processes
Financial services or fintech environments
Experience within fintech or financial services is important for this position, particularly where candidates have worked with regulated environments, complex client onboarding or technology-enabled financial processes. Experience within private markets, fund administration, investor onboarding or adjacent financial services environments would be advantageous.
Personal Attributes
Highly client-focused, with a genuine desire to understand and solve client problems
Naturally curious and comfortable asking questions to get to the root of an issue
Strong communicator who can build relationships with both clients and internal stakeholders
Highly organised with strong attention to detail
Comfortable managing multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders simultaneously

descriptions.title: Business Analyst
descriptions.description:
Role purpose
Sit between the business and the build team. Take business requirements — often incomplete, verbal, or expressed as outcomes rather than needs — and convert them into functional specifications the business can sign off, and technical specifications engineers can implement without further interpretation.
The role owns the requirement from the moment it is raised until it is delivered, tested and accepted. Success is measured by how few clarification cycles the build team needs and how little rework surfaces in UAT.
Requirements
Key responsibilities
Requirements elicitation and analysis
Run workshops, interviews and process walkthroughs with business stakeholders, subject matter experts and operations teams.
Challenge stated requirements to establish the underlying business need, the decision being supported, and the value being sought.
Identify gaps, contradictions, duplication and unstated assumptions in the source requirements, and drive them to resolution rather than escalating them unresolved.
Document current-state ("as-is") processes and define target-state ("to-be") processes, including the operational and control changes required.
Assess regulatory, audit and data-protection implications of each requirement and flag where compliance input is needed.
Functional specification
Author functional specification documents that define system behaviour in business terms: process flows, use cases or user stories, business rules, decision tables, validation logic, calculation logic, roles and permissions, notifications, and reporting outputs.
Define exception paths, error handling and edge cases explicitly — not only the happy path.
Write clear, testable acceptance criteria for every requirement.
Secure formal business sign-off on the functional specification before build commences.
Technical specification
Translate the approved functional specification into a technical specification that engineering can build against, covering:
System and component architecture in scope, and the changes required to each.
Data model changes: entities, attributes, data types, cardinality, referential integrity, retention.
Integration and interface specifications: API contracts, request/response payloads, protocols, authentication, error and retry behaviour, throughput and volumetrics.
Data migration and transformation rules, including source-to-target field mappings and cleansing logic.
Configuration versus customisation decisions, with rationale.
Non-functional requirements: performance, availability, scalability, security, auditability, logging and monitoring.
Work with solution architects and developers to validate technical feasibility, sizing and effort, and to reconcile the specification with platform constraints.
Document assumptions, dependencies, constraints and out-of-scope items.
Delivery and quality support
Maintain a requirements traceability matrix linking business requirement → functional specification → technical specification → test case → delivered feature.
Groom and maintain the backlog; ensure work items entering a sprint meet the team's definition of ready.
Support developers through build, acting as the authority on intended behaviour.
Author or review test scenarios; support SIT and UAT, triage defects, and distinguish genuine defects from change requests.
Contribute to release notes, training material, user guides and operational handover documentation.
Change and stakeholder management
Run impact assessments on change requests: effort, risk, dependencies, cost and schedule implications.
Manage version control and change history across all specification artefacts.
Keep business and technical stakeholders aligned on scope, sequencing and trade-offs, and communicate decisions and their consequences clearly to both audiences.
Deliverables owned by this role
Requirements catalogue / business requirements analysis
Functional specification document (FSD)
Technical specification document (TSD)
Process models (BPMN or equivalent) — as-is and to-be
Data dictionary and source-to-target mappings
Interface / integration specification
User stories with acceptance criteria
Requirements traceability matrix
UAT test scenarios and support for execution
Impact assessments for change requests

descriptions.description:
About us:
BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.
We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.
Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.
Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.
By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.
We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.
We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:
CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)
Location: We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy.
FUNCTION: Engineering
We're looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our Cards team. Our goal is to build out a seamless card issuing and transaction platform that bridges crypto and fiat - enabling merchants to offer their customers instant access to funds through physical and virtual cards.
Traditional card programmes have often been rigid, slow to integrate, and limited in their ability to handle multi-currency flows across crypto and fiat rails. With our platform, we're breaking down these barriers by delivering a modern card infrastructure that handles everything from tokenization and sensitive card data to real-time transaction enrichment and settlement. This allows our merchants to offer card products that work fluidly across currencies, with the security, speed, and reliability their customers expect. By building this from the ground up, we're creating a best-in-class card experience that sits at the intersection of traditional payments and digital assets.
Our product and engineering organisation is split into small autonomous squads empowered to own their problem space. You'll be expected to form strong opinions and execute in a fast but sustainable way, advocating for the simplest solution that achieves the outcomes our customers are looking for.
Key Areas of Responsibilities:
Design and implement card platform features end-to-end - from tokenization and sensitive card data handling to transaction enrichment and settlement workflows
Build and maintain integrations with card issuers and payment processors
Architect systems spanning multiple services, ensuring scalability, security, and PCI compliance
Own features and projects from inception to completion, breaking down complex domains into deliverable work items
Drive cross-team technical initiatives around shared libraries, patterns, and infrastructure
Actively review code across the team, providing constructive and in-depth feedback
Contribute to our engineering culture by mentoring teammates and setting quality standards
What we need from you:
5+ years experience as a Backend Engineer, preferably in FinTech or payments
Expertise in Java and Spring Boot
Experience building and maintaining APIs and services in a microservices architecture
Strong understanding of card payments, issuing, or transaction processing.
Enthusiasm for adopting AI-assisted development tooling (e.g, Claude Code, AI code review agents) to accelerate delivery and improve code quality across the squad.
Ability to self-direct work and scale from well-scoped tasks to multi-sprint initiatives
Excellent problem-solving skills, comfortable working independently or collaboratively across squads
Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with code review as a tool for mentoring and raising team-wide standards
Good written and verbal communication skills
Familiarity with crypto/fiat payment rails is a plus
Open to participating in an out-of-hours on-call rota
What you can expect from us:
Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
A flexible approach to holiday
Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets
At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we'd encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

descriptions.title: Full Stack Java Developer
descriptions.description:
About Unifi
Boldly different. Fiercely human. Proudly African.
Unifi is redefining credit in Africa with simple, fast personal loans delivered through online, mobile and branch channels. We make life easy for our clients across Zambia, Kenya, Uganda, South Africa and Tanzania. Unifi has conviction in the African continent and its people, and our products enable our clients to achieve even more. As one of the fastest-growing lenders in Africa, we combine exceptional client service with the very best tech and data analytics.
Purpose of the role
This role is based in Stellenbosch and would require the candidate to live in the Western Cape. Build and improve the software that powers Unifi's products and operations across Africa. Reporting to the Head Of Engineering the Full Stack Java Developer, you'll work across the full development lifecycle, partnering with your team to design, build and deliver reliable, scalable solutions that make life easier for our clients and the people who serve them. You'll take ownership, solve real business problems and help us continuously improve how we build software as Unifi grows.
Our Technology Stack
We work with a modern and diverse technology stack to deliver high-quality solutions.
Our core technologies include Groovy, Java and Kotlin (for new services) for programming, with Micronaut and Spring Boot as our primary application frameworks.
We use Gorm and Hibernate for persistence and rely on MySQL as our main database. For web-based user interfaces, we utilize Vaadin.
In addition, our technology stack features Activiti for workflow management, Micronaut and JAX-RS for microservices, and Electron for our desktop Branch Application.
We manage queue processing through Apache ActiveMQ Artemis.
Other tools in our stack include MongoDB for document storage and Apache Velocity as our template engine. We also use Swagger for API documentation.
Our development environment follows Agile Kanban methodology using Bitbucket pipelines for builds, IntelliJ as our IDE, Bitbucket Git for source control, and Gradle for build configuration.
We stay connected through Slack and Google, and manage our development cycle with Jira.
To empower our engineering team, every developer is equipped with AI assistants like Gemini and Claude Code, helping them tackle complex daily challenges and craft optimal solutions.
Responsibilities
Design, build and maintain reliable software that scales with Unifi as we grow
Build systems that are simple, secure and easy to maintain by writing clean code and choosing practical solutions over unnecessary complexity
Build observability into Unifi systems through logging, monitoring and tracing so issues can be identified and resolved quickly
Take ownership of changes from technical design through development, testing, QA handover and into production, helping deliver value to our clients and frontline teams as quickly as possible
Use AI tools such as Gemini and Claude Code responsibly to improve productivity while maintaining full ownership of every technical decision and every line of code you commit
Work closely with developers, product teams and stakeholders to solve problems, improve our products and deliver great outcomes
Contribute to the continuous improvement of our engineering practices, development processes and software architecture
Share knowledge, support your teammates and help build a collaborative, high-performing culture
Question the way something has always been built. If there is a simpler or faster way to do it, raise it and make the case
Requirements
Relevant tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field
8+ years' experience designing, building and maintaining software applications
Solid experience with Java or another JVM-based programming language
Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL and building data-driven applications
Takes ownership, pays attention to detail and enjoys seeing work through to completion
Practical problem solver who can think logically and make good technical decisions
Able to work independently while collaborating closely with teammates to get the job done
Curious, adaptable and always looking for better ways to solve problems and improve how we work
A healthy spirit of adventure and sense of humour
Passionate about Africa and excited to contribute to building products that make life easy for our clients

descriptions.title: Intermediate Full Stack Engineer
descriptions.description:
About Us
HyperionDev is one of the largest providers of accelerated tech education in EMEA and one of the oldest providers of 'coding bootcamps' in the world. We work with top universities such as Imperial College London, The London School of Economics, The University of Edinburgh, and Stellenbosch University to deliver structured technical courses and bootcamps that accelerate people into fulfilling tech careers. We have been recognised as one of the top education technology scaleups in the world and gained the financial backing of Meta (previously Facebook) which recognised us as the most socially impactful startup operating in Africa, where we initially started our work.
We are dedicated to closing the global tech skills gap and we achieve this by integrating tech education with human mentorship and expert code review powered by a workforce in Southern Africa, which lowers the cost of an accessible education in technology. This model has been successful, allowing us to reach millions of learners a year from over 60 countries. We have also partnered with government bodies such as the UK's Department for Education who provide scholarships for students to study on our bootcamps and gain employment at companies such as AstraZeneca and the United Kingdom's National Health Service (NHS).
We're backed by nearly 2000 investors, having raised the largest crowdfunding round of funding for an edtech company in history. As a primarily bootstrapped, profitable, and scale up tech business join us as we play our part in making the world a more stable, safer, and fair place.
About The Role
As an Intermediate Full Stack Engineer you will be responsible for initiating, building and maintaining all aspects of our bespoke software platforms, including but not limited to:
Our student portal
Our mentor portals
Our placements portal
Our website and payment gateways
Our sign up flows
Our data analysis platforms
Our tech stack consists primarily of Python, Django, AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, SQS, SNS, CloudWatch, Route53), Postgres, and Ubuntu
To excel in this role, you should be a creative problem solver, be enthusiastic about learning and growing your technical skills, display keen attention to detail and high standards in code quality
Please note that this is a full time position.
Responsibilities
Design and write high quality code for our website and platforms using Python and Django
Collaborate with other members of the team to execute engineering projects, plan sprint cycles, undertake technical troubleshooting, and reduce technical debt
Share knowledge freely with other members on the team and take guidance from senior engineers
Work closely with Product to help in planning, designing and creating the technical implementation of features which will be used by tens of thousands of people around the world
Refactor and improve legacy code as areas of requirements volatility are found and bug hotspots are uncovered
Communicate with technical people through clean code, precise technical documentation and well commented MR's and with non-technical people by creating work breakdowns, test plans and clear comments
Requirements
Minimum
Minimum 2 years of experience as a full stack engineer
Demonstrable commercial experience with Python
Minimum 2 years of experience with one of the following: React, Vue, or Angular
Hands on experience with Django or other Python web frameworks
Experience working with RDBMS and SQL
Experience with UNIX based operating systems
Experience with Cloud Services, preferably AWS
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Excellent attention to detail
Excellent problem solving skills
Ability to produce work of a high standard with minimal supervisions
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt in line with or ahead of external changes
Preferred
Prior tech startup experience in a high-growth and ambitious environment is preferred
Benefits
Hybrid work: We are a hybrid work organisation offering flexibility on your schedule. Remote working options are available for candidates not in proximity of a HyperionDev Campus
Learn new tech skills: We offer our employees the opportunity to enrol part-time in our Coding Bootcamps.
Join the heart of tech in Africa, Europe and the US: You'll work with the best of the best and rub shoulders with the world leaders in edtech, developer education, and developer assessments. Join one of the most ambitious and highest performing tech companies in the space, with a management team that draws their former experience from top tech companies.
Life-changing work: Solve real problems that make education and tech careers accessible to those who need it most: you're allowed to brag about it.

descriptions.title: Python Developer -Mid/Snr
descriptions.description:
Our Travelstart team is looking for an experienced Python Developer to join our Technology team and help build, improve and support the systems that power Travelstart’s products, platforms and operational services.
This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong focus on backend development, APIs, integrations and automation.
You’ll work as part of a cross-functional technology team, collaborating with Engineering, Product, Data and Operations to turn business and product requirements into reliable, scalable software.
We’re open to appointing at either mid or senior level, depending on your experience and technical capability.
For a strong mid-level developer, this is an opportunity to broaden your technical ownership and work across increasingly complex systems.
For a senior developer, we’re looking for someone comfortable operating independently, influencing technical design and helping raise engineering standards across the team.
Location: Cape Town, South Africa (Our office is located in Gardens)
What you’ll do
In This Role, You’ll
Design, develop and maintain backend applications and services using Python.
Build and support APIs and integrations across internal and third-party systems.
Develop software that is scalable, maintainable, secure and suited to a high-volume transactional environment.
Translate product and business requirements into practical technical solutions.
Improve existing systems through refactoring, automation and the reduction of technical debt.
Participate in technical design and solution discussions.
Write automated tests and participate in peer code reviews.
Work within our established source-control, CI/CD and deployment processes.
Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
Improve system performance, reliability, monitoring and observability.
Work within an Agile delivery environment and contribute to continuous team and process improvement.
Work with third-party technology providers, platforms and suppliers.
Share knowledge and contribute to the broader capability of the Engineering team.
At senior level, you’ll also be expected to contribute meaningfully to architecture and solution-design decisions, identify technical risks and improvement opportunities, and provide guidance and mentoring to less experienced developers.
What we’re looking for
You’ll Ideally Bring
Strong professional experience developing software using Python.
Experience building backend applications, APIs and integration services.
Experience with Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, Flask or similar.
A solid understanding of REST APIs and service-based architectures.
Good SQL and relational database experience.
Experience with Git and modern source-control practices.
Experience with automated testing.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines.
Experience working in containerised environments such as Docker.
Experience working with cloud-based applications or deployment environments.
A good understanding of application performance, scalability and security.
Experience developing and supporting production software.
Experience working in an Agile or iterative development environment.
A relevant tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline is advantageous, but practical experience and demonstrated capability matter more to us than a specific qualification.
We would typically expect around 4+ years of professional software-development experience, although we place greater value on the complexity of the work you’ve done, the ownership you’ve taken and the quality of your technical judgement than on an exact number of years.
Nice to have
Experience With Any Of The Following Would Be Advantageous
PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar relational databases.
Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka or similar caching, messaging or event-driven technologies.
Distributed systems or microservice architectures.
High-volume transactional platforms.
Travel, e-commerce or fintech environments.
AI tools and AI-enabled development workflows.
What matters to us
Beyond the technical skills, we’re looking for someone who:
Takes ownership and follows problems through to resolution.
Thinks beyond the immediate coding task and considers the wider system impact.
Approaches complex problems logically and pragmatically.
Makes sensible technical trade-offs rather than over-engineering solutions.
Cares about reliable, maintainable software.
Communicates technical issues clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
Raises risks, dependencies and concerns early.
Is comfortable learning new technologies and adapting as our technology environment evolves.
Contributes positively to the team and shares knowledge with others.
Mid or Senior?
We’re intentionally keeping the role open across both levels.
As a Mid-Level Python Developer, you’ll generally be comfortable working independently on well-defined features and services, taking ownership of applications or components and contributing effectively to technical discussions and code reviews.
As a Senior Python Developer, we’ll expect greater autonomy across complex or ambiguous requirements, ownership of significant services or systems, contribution to architecture and solution design, and the ability to guide and support other developers.
For us, seniority is about more than years of experience. It’s about the complexity of problems you can solve, the level of ownership you can take and the quality of your technical judgement.
Why Travelstart?
You’ll be working in a technology environment that supports a large, established travel business with multiple products, customer segments, platforms and integrations.
That means real technical complexity, plenty of problems worth solving, and meaningful opportunities to improve systems, automate processes and influence how our technology evolves.
If you enjoy building practical solutions, taking ownership of what you put into production and working in an environment where technology is continuously evolving, we’d like to hear from you.

descriptions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer
descriptions.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.
Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.
Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.
About The Role
As a Backend Senior Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you'll help build and evolve the storage and query layer that keeps Camunda 8's process data fast, accurate, and available at scale. Spanning both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, the data layer and its data pipelines power everything from process monitoring to the new agent-driven automation capabilities we're rolling out.
As part of the Data Layer team, you will work on both technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as reshaping how we store and retain process data, streaming data to external systems, and evolving our secondary storage systems to perform at ever greater scale.
At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and support, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data layer evolves to meet our customers' needs.
Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale
What You Will Do
Design, build, and maintain backend services for the data layer that stores and serves Camunda 8's process data, spanning relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with an eye toward correctness, performance, and scale.
Own the end-to-end delivery of engineering initiatives, working with Product Management and colleagues across the business to break down requirements into concrete solution designs, driving projects to timely and high-quality delivery.
Help evolve how we process, retain, and expose process data, so customers can work with their data the way they need to.
Invest in making our secondary storage systems more performant and scalable as usage grows, and build tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate the data layer in production.
Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.
Must Haves
What You Will Bring to the Role:
At least 7 years of experience as a backend engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores
Deep experience with both Relational Databases (ideally PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, or MSSQL), and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a practical understanding of query performance, indexing, and data modeling trade-offs
Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end — solution design, project planning, coordinating across teams, and driving predictable delivery.
Comfortable investigating slow queries, execution plans, and index usage to root-cause data-related production issues.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.
Nice To Haves
Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software.
Experience building or maintaining CI pipelines.
Understanding of database migration tooling (e.g. Liquibase, Flyway) and schema evolution in a live system.
This role is an existing vacancy
#C1
Compensation
What We Have to Offer:
We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.
The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:
United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00
United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00
Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00
Canada: C$152,700.00 to C$251,200.00
If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.
Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).
Benefits & Perks
We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.
Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.
In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.
Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.
Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.
Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!
AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here
”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!
Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!
Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.
Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

descriptions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Shopify)
descriptions.description:
About Impact.com
impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products—Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral)—unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands, including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics, rely on impact.com to power more than 225,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.
Your Role at Impact.com
We're looking for someone who knows Shopify well enough to challenge how we're using it.
This isn't a role for someone who simply builds Shopify features. It's for an engineer who understands Shopify's platform deeply and wants to influence how one of the world's largest partnership platforms integrates with it.
Reporting to the Engineering Manager, E-commerce Platform Integrations, you'll own and evolve impact.com's Shopify integration - a critical platform connecting thousands of merchants directly to our ecosystem.
You'll help shape our approach to Shopify Apps, Web Pixels, merchant onboarding, API integrations and platform architecture while ensuring our integration continues to evolve alongside Shopify itself.
If you're the kind of engineer who enjoys reading Shopify release notes, experimenting with new platform capabilities, debating architecture decisions and building systems that scale across thousands of merchants, we'd love to talk to you.
What You'll Own
Own the development and evolution of our Shopify integration, including Apps, Web Pixels and platform extensions. Build reliable, privacy-compliant solutions that accurately capture conversions, refunds and customer events while adapting to Shopify's evolving platform capabilities.
Design and improve the complete merchant installation experience. You'll build secure OAuth flows, manage credentials, automate onboarding and ensure merchants can install and activate Impact with minimal friction.
Build and maintain the Ruby on Rails application that connects Shopify with Impact's APIs and workflow engine.
You'll design resilient webhook consumers, manage high-volume data pipelines and ensure reliable synchronisation between platforms.
While Ruby on Rails is our primary backend technology, we're happy to support experienced Shopify engineers in developing deeper Rails expertise.
Own the health of our Shopify integration in production.
You'll proactively manage API version upgrades, monitor webhook delivery, troubleshoot merchant-specific issues and ensure the platform remains performant, secure and resilient as Shopify evolves.
We don't want someone who simply maintains an integration. We want someone who can improve it.
You'll help us identify better ways of using Shopify's platform, evaluate new capabilities such as Checkout Extensibility, Functions and Web Pixels, and influence the future direction of our Shopify ecosystem.
What You'll Bring
You've built production Shopify Apps, integrations or platform extensions and understand the Shopify ecosystem beyond storefront development.
Ideally you've worked with technologies such as Shopify Apps, Checkout UI Extensions, Web Pixels, Shopify Functions, App Bridge, GraphQL Admin API, OAuth, Webhooks, Shopify Partner Dashboard
You've built integrations between complex SaaS platforms and understand how to design reliable event-driven systems.
You're comfortable working with REST and GraphQL APIs, OAuth authentication, Webhooks, Rate limiting, Background processing, High-volume event pipelines
You have experience building and maintaining production backend services.
Ruby on Rails experience is preferred, but we're equally interested in experienced Shopify engineers who have worked with technologies such as Node.js, Python, PHP or Java and are excited to work with Rails
You're comfortable working with modern JavaScript or TypeScript and understand how browser-based tracking technologies operate within Shopify's platform
You think beyond individual features. You understand how changes to one system affect another and enjoy designing reusable, scalable solutions that work across thousands of merchants rather than solving one-off problems
We'd Love To See Experience With
Shopify Plus
Marketing attribution
Affiliate platforms
Conversion tracking
Analytics platforms
Commerce integrations
Workflow automation
CI/CD pipelines
Production monitoring and observability
Benefits and Perks:
At impact.com, we believe that when you’re happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.
Flexible Working: Our Responsible PTO policy means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.
Health and Wellness: Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to 12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year, with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a monthly gym reimbursement policy to support your physical health.
A Stake in Our Growth: We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.
Investing in Your Growth: We’re committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.
Parental Support: We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.
Technology Financial Support: We provide a technology stipend to help you set up your home office and a monthly allowance to cover your internet expenses

descriptions.title: Senior Backend Developer
descriptions.description:
The Opportunity
We are looking to speak with experienced Backend Developers with strong .NET expertise to join a growing technology environment. The role will focus on designing and developing scalable backend services, APIs and database solutions, while working closely with other technical teams to deliver robust applications.
Core Responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain scalable backend systems and APIs using .NET Core, with a focus on Web API and Worker Services.
Design, optimise and maintain SQL Server databases, with a focus on performance, scalability and reliability.
Develop and implement effective database design, query optimisation and indexing strategies.
Implement and manage distributed caching solutions to improve application performance and scalability.
Work closely with frontend developers and other technical stakeholders to ensure effective integration between backend services and applications.
Troubleshoot, optimise and continuously improve existing systems and services.
Required Skills & Experience
.NET Core
Strong commercial experience developing backend applications using .NET Core.
Proven experience building RESTful APIs and background services using Worker Services.
Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, dependency injection and middleware.
Experience designing scalable and maintainable backend architectures.
SQL Server
Strong experience with SQL Server, including database schema design and optimisation.
Proven ability to optimise queries and troubleshoot database performance issues.
Experience with indexing, stored procedures, views and complex joins.
Strong understanding of database performance and scalability.
Distributed Caching
Hands-on experience implementing caching strategies within backend applications.
Understanding of how distributed caching can be used to reduce latency and improve application performance.
JavaScript / Frontend Exposure
Experience integrating backend services with JavaScript-based frontend applications.
Ability to troubleshoot and support issues relating to API consumption and backend/frontend integration.
Advantageous Skills
Experience with any of the following would be beneficial:
Elasticsearch – search functionality, indexing and analytics.
Redis – distributed caching, session management and/or pub/sub messaging.
RabbitMQ – message queuing, asynchronous processing and event-driven architectures.
Ideal Background
The ideal candidate will be a hands-on Backend Developer who is comfortable working across .NET Core, APIs and SQL Server, with a strong understanding of performance, scalability and backend architecture. Experience with distributed systems, caching and messaging technologies would be advantageous.

Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
Role Overview
The ServiceNow QA Engineer is a hands-on technical testing role within the NTT DATA ServiceNow Practice, responsible for executing test activities across the full development lifecycle. Working closely with the QA Manager, Business Analysts, and development team, the QA Engineer ensures that all developed functionality is tested thoroughly, accurately, and in line with the quality standards set by the QA Manager and Practice.
The QA Engineer is an executor — their primary focus is on building and running test cases, contributing to the automated test framework, and providing timely, accurate feedback on quality across sprints and releases. They will cover development from the Practice, ATS, and automations teams, operating as part of the shared QA function.
Key Responsibilities
Execute functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing across all ServiceNow development in line with the test plans defined by the QA Manager.
Write clear, well-structured test cases and test scripts based on user stories and acceptance criteria provided by the Business Analyst.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test scripts within the ServiceNow ATF (Automated Test Framework), expanding coverage across product domains.
Execute regression testing ahead of each release and platform upgrade, using the automated test suite to validate platform stability.
Log, track, and retest defects accurately and in a timely manner, ensuring developers receive clear, reproducible defect reports.
Support UAT coordination activities — setting up test environments, providing test data, and assisting business stakeholders through test execution.
Maintain test cases and test scripts in the shared test repository, keeping them up to date as platform changes are made.
Contribute to quality reporting by providing accurate test execution status, pass/fail rates, and defect metrics to the QA Manager.
Participate in sprint ceremonies — including backlog grooming and sprint reviews — to ensure testability is considered from story creation through to delivery.
Essential Experience & Skills
Proven experience in a QA Engineer or software testing role within a ServiceNow or enterprise platform delivery environment.
Practical experience using ServiceNow ATF (Automated Test Framework) to build and execute automated test scripts.
Strong skills in writing test cases and test scripts from user stories and acceptance criteria.
Experience executing functional, regression, and integration testing within an agile delivery environment.
Ability to write clear, reproducible defect reports and manage defects through to resolution.
Comfortable working across multiple product domains, picking up context quickly and adapting testing approaches accordingly.
Desirable
Experience with platform upgrade testing in ServiceNow, including regression test execution during upgrade cycles.
Familiarity with ISTQB Foundation or equivalent testing qualification.
Exposure to broader test automation tools or scripting in addition to ServiceNow ATF.
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or equivalent product knowledge.
Experience supporting UAT with business stakeholders, including test environment setup and guidance through test execution.
Behaviours & Competencies
Detail-oriented — takes pride in thorough, accurate test coverage and clear defect reporting.
Reliable — consistently delivers test outputs on time and to the standard required by the QA Manager.
Collaborative — works well with developers, BAs, and business stakeholders as part of a wider delivery team.
Curious — proactively looks for edge cases, gaps in coverage, and quality risks beyond the immediate test plan.
Continuous improver — actively contributes to building out the automated test suite and raising QA maturity over time.

We are a proudly homegrown African company, building the future of sports and iGaming entertainment across the continent. Since our launch in 2018, we've created platforms that connect millions of fans to the excitement they love through our leading brands, BetKing and SuperSportBet.
From Nigeria to South Africa, we've rapidly grown into a powerhouse, recognized for raising standards, pushing boundaries, and shaping what's next in our industry. Our vision is bold: to be the home where Africa plays.
Collaboration, innovation, and fearless execution define our culture. Every decision is purposeful, every interaction impactful, and every product designed to serve our players and partners with excellence.
We move fast, stay curious, and constantly raise the bar. Our mission is to deliver entertainment with integrity, innovation, and impact - because great products can change how entire communities experience play.
About The Role
We're looking for a Principal Backend Engineer to take a key role in shaping the architecture and technical direction of our platform.
You'll design systems that handle millions of transactions, improve performance across services, and ensure our technology can scale safely and efficiently as the business grows.
You'll act as a technical leader and hands-on architect, guiding teams, raising the quality bar, and helping us make smart, sustainable engineering decisions.
What You'll Be Doing
Architect the future: design, implement, and evolve distributed systems that handle high throughput and millions of concurrent transactions
Provide technical leadership: act as a go-to expert for backend and infrastructure topics, mentoring teams and raising the overall engineering bar
Optimize performance: identify bottlenecks and design scalable solutions that improve availability, latency, and cost efficiency
Drive reliability: establish solid standards for monitoring, alerting, and incident management, ensuring our systems are observable and resilient

Languages & Frameworks: C#, .NET 8, .NET Core
Messaging & Streaming: Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus
Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB, CosmosDB, Redis
Infrastructure & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Azure Cloud

We're looking for someone who thrives in complexity and is driven by the pursuit of excellence. To succeed in this role, you'll need:
10+ years of engineering leadership, with a proven track record of delivering large-scale, distributed systems
Expertise in some cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), DevOps practices (CI/CD), Microservices (AKS), Kafka/RabbitMQ streams and programming languages (C#, or others)
Demonstrated ability to quickly address production incidents and implement preventive measures to avoid recurrence
Proven capability to maintain product quality through unit testing and end-to-end testing processes
The ability to foresee future challenges, craft innovative solutions, and implement strategies that drive meaningful impact
Exceptional communication skills to work effectively across teams and influence stakeholders at all levels
While iGaming experience is a plus, what matters most is your ability to solve real-world problems with creativity and precision
Benefits
As part of the KingMakers team in South Africa, you'll enjoy a range of benefits designed to support your wellbeing, flexibility, and future:
✨ Flexible Work – A hybrid model with 2 days in the office and 3 days working remotely, plus flexible working hours. This role is based in Cape Town, so candidates must be based there or willing to relocate.
🌍 Work from Anywhere – Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from a location of your choice for up to 10 business days per year.
💚 Health & Wellbeing – Company contributions towards your Discovery Health Medical Aid, plus access to our Employee Wellness Programme (ICAS / October Health), offering confidential counselling and wellbeing support for you and your immediate family.
💰 Retirement & Group Risk – A company-supported Liberty Life Pension Fund with employer matching contributions, along with comprehensive Group Risk cover, including life insurance, disability income protection, critical illness, and funeral cover for you and your eligible dependants.
🎉 Time Off – 20 working days of annual leave each year, plus an extra Birthday Day Off to celebrate your special day.
🚗 Stress-Free Parking – Complimentary company-supported parking at our Cape Town office.
💻 Top-Notch Tech – A high-performance laptop and the tools you need to do your best work.
🏟️ Team Activities – Regular opportunities to connect, collaborate, and celebrate with your colleagues.
🏆 Performance Bonus – A discretionary annual bonus that recognizes your contributions and impact.
Please note: Eligibility for the discretionary bonus depends on your onboarding cycle and start date. Employees joining after a certain point in the year may not be eligible for the 2026 bonus cycle.
Our Commitment to Inclusion
At KingMakers, we're committed to building diverse and inclusive teams that reflect the communities and markets we serve across Africa. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities and strive to create an environment where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
In line with our Employment Equity commitments, preference may be given to candidates from designated groups where appropriate.
